RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Bennett Racing P/L, Rosemont Stud P/L Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (19-weeks). Won the Maribyrnong Plate in his maiden campaign. 3rd & 1st at latest Warwick Farm trials. Can play a role fresh.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (21-weeks). Placed in Blue Diamond before compounding after racing on pace in Golden Slipper. 3rd & 2nd at recent Flemington jump-outs. Looks a major player.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Impressive debut at Flemington 14 Feb. Raced keenly & gave up the ghost quickly first-up. Look for improvement here & warrants attention.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Makybe Racing & Breeding Pty Ltd, Cavalluccio Et Al
Spotlight: Second campaign (22-weeks). Further matured. Nice win of the VOBIS Showdown last prep. 2nds at recent jump-outs at Pakenham Syn. Watch closely.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (19-weeks). Stakes-placed colt. Given two trials. Lone victory was over this trip. Place preferred.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mrs K Flaherty, Baxter Lodge Racing No 1 Et Al
Spotlight: Responded well from back half to get the prize at Flemington at second outing. Could give some cheek at odds.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Back for second campaign (25-weeks). More developed now. In the market all runs. Placed at Rosehill on debut last campaign while showing enough in recent trials. Hope for exotics.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: D Rogers, Mrs K Rogers Et Al
Spotlight: Short odds and duly saluted at Sale on debut. Can fill the minors here.

RaceName: Tobin Brothers Vain Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: K W Breese, Mrs J R Breese Et Al
Spotlight: Waltzed in at Echuca at second outing. in the slosh. Has claims for a repeat.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Back for second campaign (23-weeks).Undefeated mare having her first run across the ditch. Latest run was a G1 win at Ellerslie. Michael Dee stays on board. Major player.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Kurrinda Bloodstock, Mrs Y Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (21-weeks). Won the 2yo F Swp in her maiden campaign. Did a terrific job in her first campaign. Has a tricky draw and rising in weight. Place looks best.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Australian T'bred B'stock Pty Ltd, J E J Ciurlionis Et Al
Spotlight: Had all before her at turn and went home tamely at Flemington for new stable. Untried in the wet. Hard to make a case.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: J A O'Neill, Mrs M F Anderson Et Al
Spotlight: Last assignment this trip when handily placed and worked home soundly this course. Has a tricky draw. Shapes as a rough place prospect.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Kildalton Park Racing, N B Smith Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (12-weeks). Smart debut at Caulfield 9 May & then went on to run 2nd at Gold Coast. Looks very promising. 2nd & 1st at latest jump-outs. Right in this.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Lindsay Park Bloodstock, Needham Racing Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Just got there in the 2yo (Open) at Flemington in rain affected going last start. Soft tick, heavy query. Could repeat without surprise.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Terrific winning the 2yo Hcp over 1100m at Randwick at $7.50. Drawn to effect. Soft proven, heavy unknown. Capable of figuring again.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Kept fresh since resuming. Reserved midfield and picked up intently in choppy conditions at Rosehill off spell. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. One for your exotics.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Made an immediate impact with a convincing win in soft going at Flemington. Can win again.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: M Hymet, R Griffiths Et Al
Spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (20-weeks). Stakes-placed in first prep., Strikes a stronger field.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Resolute Racing, C Massie Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Off the speed, picked up soundly and wasn't beaten far at Eagle Farm. Since trialled at Warwick Farm 4 Aug. Others with greater appeal.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Miss J Banks, Mrs C L Lovatt, Mrs S Cusack & M Hooton
Spotlight: Kept fresh. Gritty on pace victory 2yo F Mdn at Warwick Farm for new stable. Has an adverse draw. Prefer others.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: 5 weeks since last run. Game effort this track in choppy conditions second-up. More a minor money chance here.

RaceName: Quayclean Quezette Stakes (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Excellent debut performance when just nabbed at Flemington at $21. Worth a look again.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Proven Thoroughbreds, P Yates Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Grand camapigner who loves a first-up run. Only got the wobbles late in the Stradbroke after leading them up last time. Must be considered.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mystery Downs, Mrs C M Cook Et Al
Spotlight: Resuming (19-weeks). Placed in elite company last prep and has had a 2nd & 1st at recent jump-outs. Barrier hurts but possesses early toe. Can definitely play a role.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Halo Racing Services Pty Ltd, Ms D M Suss Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (27-weeks). Long time since last saluted. Trial & jump-out were pleasing. Rough exotics hope.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Finished well held in heavy ground at Eagle Farm over today's trip. Has won multiple times in wet. Can make his presence felt fresh in this line-up.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: E Jusufovic, P J Fulton Et Al
Spotlight: Kept fresh following return when got home super behind Coeur Volante here. Can run a race at odds.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Sutton Racing Pty Ltd, S Chappell Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). Has run well fresh. Soft tick, heavy query. Not out of this fresh in this company.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Great effort in the The Gold Rush Ascot two back. Stationed mid and sustained a strong run this course for his new stable. Has an excellent second-up record & Pikey comes for the ride. Hard to beat.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: C J Waller, Go Bloodstock Australia Et Al
Spotlight: First-up (18-weeks). Better suited to longer assignments these days. Others more persuasive.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Regal Bloodstock, R Livori Et Al
Spotlight: Let-up (42-days). Finished a long way from the action Glasshouse Hcp at Sunshine Coast. Adverse barrier tests. Leaning towards others here.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: N A Greenhalgh, Mrs M T Greenhalgh et al
Spotlight: First-up (17-weeks). Sound win at Mornington last time. Meets a stronger bunch here .

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Widden Stud Pty Ltd & Bangaloe Stud
Spotlight: Caulfield winner two back. Not far off them at Flemington in a leader dominataed race. Each way claims.

RaceName: Catanach's Jewellers P.B. Lawrence Stakes (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (18-weeks). Ex New Zealander. Steps out for third Aust start. Australian Oaks winner at Randwick last start back in April. Big watch.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has won three of 12 starts, including a Listed success, and is in good form (just in front of Indalimos at Chantilly last time but now 3lb worse off); return to this trip should suit but more needed to win on these terms back in Group company.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Best effort came when beating subsequent Group 1 winner Consent and Rabbit's Foot (has improved since) in Group 3 on this weekend a year ago; mainly creditable efforts since, though held by Rabbit's Foot on Chantilly form over this trip on fast ground in June.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has won half her eight starts and turned in best effort to win Listed event at Clairefontaine on ground described as soft this month; handles a sound surface and should give a good account.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Claims on pick of efforts, which includes a third placing behind Aventure in Longchamp Group 2 over 1m2f110yds in May; respectable effort at Vichy last time and a player back up in trip.

RaceName: JRA Prix Alec Head (Prix de Pomone) (Group 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Group 1-placed last year and ran to best when beating last weekend's German Group 1 winner Tiffany over 1m4f on fast ground at Chantilly in June (below-par Indalimos back in seventh); the one to beat on that evidence.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 15,000euros yearling; Mehmas colt; half-brother to winners Geometrical (Group-placed 7.5f/1m) and Slaney Tide (1m2f); dam unraced half-sister to smart 1m/1m2f winner King's Gambit, out of sister to 1m Group 1 winner Sophisticat; trip sharp on pedigree.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: No impact on sole 2yo run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel and early speed on return at Cork last month, weakening into midfield; drops in trip and tongue-tie tried.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Half-brother to yard's smart 7f/8f performer Indigo Five; didn't count last month in 6f maidens at Navan and Cork; drop back in trip unlikely to suit and eligible for a mark after this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: N W T Dalzell & Edward Lynam
Spotlight: Three runs here in the spring were ordinary enough when never really competitive; can't rule out on return but looks a more likely one for handicaps.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Big odds, soundly beaten twice in Curragh maidens in June; back in trip and seems best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sister to Listed-winning sprinter Grand Marques; keen enough on both maiden runs in the spring, second occasion not quite getting home over stiff finish at Navan when third (second won next time and now rated 90); that looks decent form and could well play a major role here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Placings last autumn included over C&D; hasn't improved this year but wasn't beaten far in Curragh handicap; recent Navan maiden fourth was a good bit below best; should be thereabouts but possibly vulnerable.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Shaped okay on second start last season in Navan maiden, not so good on comeback run at Cork in June; seems the lesser likely of the Stack pair and draw far from ideal.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; not beaten too far on yard debut last month in Curragh handicap despite slow start; more needed however back in maiden company.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Ducked right at start when well held in maidens at the Curragh and Navan; headgear combination now fitted and seems best watched.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sister to Group 3-winning sprinter Ostraka and half-sister to 5f/6f winner Charlemont; dam Listed-placed 5f winner, is half-sister to 6f Group 3 winner Osterhase; visored when shaping with definite promise on Cork debut in June, weakening late on when fourth (third won next time); better for that and could play a major role here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Experienced filly began the season on a rating of 80, having twice finished second in Curragh 2yo maidens; regressive this season though and needs to bounce back; good draw.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: A neck behind Tabletalk in Listed race at York (1m6f, good) on penultimate start and a head in front of him when getting up close home in a six-runner Group 3 over that same C&D (good to firm) on latest; 3lb worse off this time and back in trip but this progressive 5yo needs plenty of respect.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: Exors of the late Mohamed Obaida
Spotlight: 8yo with high-class performances around the globe over 1m2f-1m4f but he's never been beyond that; below form in Australia in April when last seen but his performance there the time before was up with his best form; usually runs well after a break; there's a question whether ground firmer than good is ideal but he is very much the class act in this field.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who has come into his own in a major way; second on good to firm at Newmarket (1m4f) and Royal Ascot (1m6f) in his last two starts; has since changed hands and left the Gosdens; climbing the ladder and although another major step up is required against Dubai Honour on this move out of handicaps, he should be highly competitive against the rest.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Won the Melrose Handicap at York in August 2024; 0-10 since but runner-up in six of those races, including at York (1m6f) on last two starts in close finishes also involving Mount Atlas (who now carries a 3lb penalty); the lack of a recent win has become frustrating, particularly as he had the initiative for most of the closing stages last time, losing it in the last three strides; cheekpieces (tried once last term, runner-up) return; second to Dubai Honour in terms of form.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: Sonny Grebe, Aus Bloodstock, D Gilbert
Spotlight: 3-6 in handicaps, including winning warm events on good to firm at Ascot (1m4f) and Carlisle (1m3f) on first two starts this year; absolutely hacked up in the latter but subsided disappointingly in the closing stages for valuable 1m6f handicap at Newmarket (made most) 16 days later; dam is sister to a 1m5f-2m winner, suggesting he should stay beyond 1m4f; even if back on song, however, this rise in class suggests he will register a place at best.

RaceName: Highclere Thoroughbred Racing Geoffrey Freer Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Grabbed a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in November and came from last to second in a six-runner Listed race at Epsom (1m2f, good; 33-1) in April; 66-1 but rallied well for sixth of 14 in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft) ten weeks ago, admittedly about 10l behind the winner, so he has a lot to find on ratings, but this St Leger entry probably has untapped potential at 1m4f+.

RaceName: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Half-brother to Daryz; impressive on debut at Saint-Cloud (1m, soft) in May and was then only 3l behind Constitution River when upped to Group 1 company straightaway for the Prix du Jockey Club (1m2f110yds, good); didn't need to be anywhere near that level when winning last time and remains with a ton of potential; holds Group 1 entries.

RaceName: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Mostly progressive colt and won a 1m4f maiden at Saint-Cloud in April (good to soft) on fourth start before improving on the figures in Pattern company, the most recent the Group 2 Prix Eugene Adam (1m2f, good); needs a bit extra but does come into this on the up.

RaceName: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won a Leopardstown maiden last August by 8l (1m, good), and improved this campaign with a tongue-tie on; his third in the Group 1 Prix du Jockey Club (1m2f110yds, good), when Daryzan was seventh, is the best form in this race and should have plenty more to offer on just his fifth start; likes to go from the front and is entered in Group 1s, including the St Leger.

RaceName: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Started the year in great form on the AW, and his defeat of Segall on that surface in March got a recent boost, but something to prove following his eighth in the Group 2 Derby Italiano (1m3f, heavy) in early June; quicker ground could help others easier to make cases for.

RaceName: Prix Guillaume d'Ornano (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Showed good form as a 2yo, notably when third in the Group 1 Criterium de Saint-Cloud (1m2f, very soft) in October, but wasn't seen again until a month ago when making all for a Listed-race success at Compiegne (1m2f, good to soft); needs another step forward but is an interesting colt.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Queen's Best (1m2f Group 3; dam of 1m2f BC Filly & Mare Turf winner Queen's Trust) and Reverie Solitaire (1m4f Listed), out of 7f Group 3 winner; yard's superstar racehorse Baaeed was off the mark on Wednesday, for the Gosdens, with just his third runner as a sire; this stable will be keen to join the party and market clues invaluable.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: By Ghaiyyath; eighth foal; closely related to Group-placed 1m 2yo winner Turgenev (including AW; RPR 113), half-brother to three winners including Manobo (1m2f-1m7f including Group 2; 115) and Tagabawa (8.6f 2yo/1m4f AW; 98); dam 1m-1m2f winner (including 2yo/Group 2; 116); leading yard has a strong hand with its juveniles and this one holds a Royal Lodge entry.

RaceName: Betway Boosts EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 150,000gns breeze-up purchase in April; Frankel second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 108), sister to smart 1m-1m4f winner Secret State, half-sister to US Grade 1 BC Juvenile Turf winner Line Of Duty, out of disqualified 1,000 Guineas winner Jacqueline Quest; plenty of appeal on paper and the betting should prove informative.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: Very useful on the Flat in his prime and returned from long absence with two encouraging hurdle runs for new stable this season, latterly when close fifth at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago; that form already gives him good claims and he could quite plausibly have a bigger run in him.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed only minor promise when 66-1 for hurdling debut over C&D (good to soft) three months ago; probably one for a bit further down the line.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Lost out by only a short head on stable/handicap hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in March 2025; that form puts him right in the thick of things here but he returned from a long absence with two disappointing AW runs this spring and needs to prove his wellbeing; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Not beaten that far when sixth of nine in good-ground Worcester bumper in June, his second start, but needs to take a big step forward on this hurdling debut.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair Flat racer who posted the best of his three hurdle runs when second to a fairly useful rival at Huntington (2m, good to firm) in May; not seen since but enters calculations.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Regressive maiden on the Flat; outran triple-digit odds when respectable sixth (just behind Biggles) on hurdle debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good) three weeks ago but needs improvement.

RaceName: Visit Perth Museum Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Left Emmet Mullins after a disappointing run in May but was back in good nick for new stable last month, going close in similar race to this over C&D (good); will play a major role if in similar form.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: £30,000 half-brother to winners Under The Twilight (6f/7f including AW; RPR 95) and Miss Nightcap (6f turf/7f AW; 92); dam 6f winner (86); the stable has yet to have a 2yo winner but bred to have a future and Danny Tudhope is 2-9 for the stable; has the outside stall but still worth a second look in the betting.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: £32,000 yearling; closely related to 1m-1m2f winner Zarabanda (RPR 102); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (91); her stable isn't really noted for 2yo winners but reasonable pedigree warrants a betting check.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Green and never involved on 6f Newbury debut 37 days ago; has stamina in his pedigree, though, so the 2f step up in trip could see him in a better light.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Left debut behind when third over 7f at York (good to firm) 22 days ago but the reopposing Coral Cove was 7l ahead of him; 1m is bred to suit but even a 6lb swing in the weights with James Owen's filly doesn't look enough.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: More one for low-grade nurseries based on his efforts over 6f/7f last month.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made an encouraging start when second of 11 over 7f at Carlisle (good to firm) in June; sent off second favourite to Coral Cove at York a month later but weakened quickly (hung right) to finish last of eight; subsequently gelded; needs to recapture the debut form.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her Doncaster debut second when pulling well clear at York (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago, with a few of today's rivals behind; 1m will suit and ought to take a bit of stopping if she can get across and obtain a good position from her wide draw.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Completely blew the start when trailing home last on debut; got away on terms and showed ability when fifth of 13 at Redcar (7f, good to firm) since, with the reopposing Tommo's Queen narrowly ahead in fourth.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Modest form in two 7f starts, beaten just under 7l when third at Musselburgh in cheekpieces (retained) latterly; improvement needed now stepping up to 1m.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 33-1, finished a neck behind reopposing stablemate Rule Of The Agency when fourth to Coral Cove on last month's York debut (7f, good to firm); should improve for the experience.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has reached the frame on all three outings since his debut but his form is little better than modest and latest Chesptow fourth was over 6f so this is a different test; the good form of his stable's juveniles provides hope, though.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 40-1 when well held on 7f Newcastle debut seven weeks ago; can only watch after that.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Cracksman filly who was green but displayed promise once she got the hang of things when fourth of 13 on 7f Redcar debut (good to firm) four weeks ago; 1m will suit and she's open to improvement.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promising debut in 6f Fairyhouse median sires series race last month when strong-finishing second after meeting trouble in running; week later showed good early speed in much better-class fillies' maiden over same C&D in finishing fourth; one to consider.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Eclipse T'bred Partners/Gaynor Bloodstock LLC/F Gallagher
Spotlight: Second in Naas barrier trial in May before satisfactory debut five days later when third in Listowel maiden; didn't improve on that when beaten favourite in Bellewstown auction maiden (albeit winner won again next time), never really overcoming a slow start over 5f; return to 6f to suit and tongue-tie tried; draw a negative.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Blue Point filly has been highly tried the last twice, staying on fifth (beaten 3.5l) in Naas Listed and outclassed in Group 3 Silver Flash at Leopardstown last month (7f); drops in trip for first run in maiden company so has to be respected.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Recent Sligo fourth (6f, yielding) a step in the right direction but more required here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 32,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Arkendale (1m; RPR 89) and Ajdayet (8.6f AW; 83); dam 1m2f-1m4f maiden (71), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Intense Focus; debutante probably best watched unless market speaks.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; dam 1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 96), half-sister to 7f/1m Listed winner Shuwari, out of US 1m1f Grade 3 winner, is granddaughter of 1m1f winning half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Annie Power; seventh of ten in a Naas barrier trial (behind Hip Hop Chrissy) in May.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starman filly cost 38,000euros as a yearling; third foal; dam unplaced over 5f, closely related to French 1m/1m4f winner Bolt Of Thunder, half-sister to 5f-7f winner Classy Clarets; slow to break, some late headway under considerate handling on debut into midfield in very valuable Ballyhane Stakes at Naas early this month; entitled to improve for that.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 15,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 9.5f AW winner, is sister to 2yo Group 3 winner/1m Group 1-placed Marie's Diamond; green, never featured but some late headway on last month's Gowran debut (7f); better for that experience but not sure this drop in trip will suit.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Bayside Boy filly a 30,000gns foal; second foal; half-sister to Italian 5.5f/6f winner Invincible Ronaldo (inc 2yo); dam French 6f-1m 2yo winner, out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; market likely best guide on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Inns Of Court half-sister to winners Formidable Force (6f; RPR 86), Amaan (6f/7f inc 2yo/Bahrain; 86) and Karnavaal (7f; 85); dam twice-raced (62) sister to US 1m3f Grade 1 winner Prince Arch; debutante probably all the better for the experience.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Magna Grecia half-sister to winners Catalyse (6f 2yo; RPR 87) and Toosha (German 6f AW); dam placed 6f 2yo (67), closely related to 11.6f Listed winner Kilimanjaro; newcomer best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Cheaply bought Twilight Sun filly never counted on recent Sligo debut when a 20-1 chance; best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100-1, never sighted when towards rear in good-class Curragh fillies contest last Sunday; can only be watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Dandy Man filly cost 3,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to Qatari 6f-1m winner Mister Staple (inc 2yo); dam French 8.5f/1m1f AW winner (RPR 97), out of 7f 2yo/1m winning sister to Cheveley Park winner Magical Romance; headgear combination on for debut.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Has added to his impressive tally with two further 5f wins this season but recent defeats suggest he's gone off the boil somewhat; dropped 2lb since last run but may need some more assistance from the handicapper.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Likeable 8yo mare with a consistent record and ten wins to her name; as good as ever when third of 23 at Glorious Goodwood (5f, good) last month, keeping on gamely; should go well again off 1lb higher.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Both 2026 wins were 5f and he was decisively on top at Sandown (good ground) 17 days ago; that was a personal best and he's in the mix, although significantly worse off at the weights with Sandown runner-up Hypnotised.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: In and out this season but has gained 5f wins at Musselburgh (good) and York (good to firm); not entirely disgraced in big field at Goodwood last time and could make his presence felt.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Gained three 5f wins in the second half of 2025, but disappointing this year after a promising reappearance; needs to get back on track but drops back in grade after facing a stiff task in York Grade 3 last time.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Dual 6f winner in 2025; regressive in 2026, tenth of 13 at Windsor last time on first run after wind surgery; very best form is over further but he has fallen below his last winning mark and Seamus Cronin's claim is a plus.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f novice as a 2yo and he ran over 1m on his reappearance, but his two runs since have been over this distance; went off favourite but met trouble on both occasions, and he has since been gelded; hard to pin down but he's relatively lightly raced and probably has more to offer.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort when getting off the mark on turf at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June; lost his chance at the start next time and then seemed to find things happening too quickly over Goodwood's sharp 5f; today's stiffer track should be in his favour, and we may not have seen the best of him yet.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won this 12 months ago off 9lb higher; 0-15 since and a change of headgear (retained) failed to stop the slide at Ascot three weeks ago.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Speedy type who will probably prove best at 5f; having first run after gelding operation and three months off when second to Wheels Of Fire at Sandown; may well improve for that outing and he still has untapped potential.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Goodwood (5f, good) in the spring and has remained in form, second of seven at Lingfield last time; no obvious reason why he won't be thereabouts again but he's fully exposed after 52 starts.

RaceName: D&H, Excellence In Nutrition Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win over 7f as 2yo for Brian Ellison; never dangerous over 6f on yard debut at Goodwood 17 days ago and now drops back even further in trip.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: A two-time 1m winner here in 2025; made a promising return when fourth at Newmarket in May but well held in 1m handicaps at Carlisle and York since; has a bit to prove now.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Failed to go on from his reappearance when only tenth in 1m4f York handicap in May; has since undergone wind surgery though so last year's winner can't be discounted now back off the same mark.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a first win of 2026 at Pontefract (1m) in June but he beat only one in 1m Redcar handicap a week ago; much more is required from this course scorer.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Veteran who is enjoying a fine season and bagged win number five when completing a hat-trick in 1m2f handicap at Ripon 12 days ago; this likeable front runner merits serious consideration nudged up 1lb.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Yarmouth (1m2f) in June but he followed it with much lesser efforts in 1m2f handicaps at Windsor and Pontefract; others are preferred.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Winless since 2024 but in good form this season until last of six (in refitted cheekpieces) in 1m2f Epsom handicap 16 days ago; headgear is quickly dispensed with and this course scorer is the sort to bounce back.

RaceName: Suit Direct At Meadowhall Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with breakthrough victory at Wolverhampton (7f) in January for Jane Chapple-Hyam; in decent form since for current yard until only seventh in 1m2f handicap at Chester 13 days ago; needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 7f; on a two-year losing spell but he's finished runner-up on his last three outings, including when dropped back to 6f here (good to firm) last Friday; races from the same mark and this previous course winner looks sure to be involved.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Completed a 6f hat-trick last spring but signed off for William Haggas with last of 13 at Newcastle in November; had been gelded before racing too freely on his stable debut/reappearance 19 days ago; that should have knocked some freshness out of him and he's back on his last winning mark.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: He was 4lb lower when beating Strike to take this race in 2024; could only finish fifth last year but he took advantage of a reduced mark to score at Redcar (6f, good to firm; First Folio fourth) 17 days ago; back up 5lb but he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Only beaten 1l when fourth in this in 2024; no wins last year and he weakened to finish 5l behind Archduke Ferdinand at Redcar last time; continues to edge down the weights.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Sole start here saw him finish eighth in the 2023 edition of this; picked up a Thirsk handicap last May but no wins since and his last two efforts have been modest, albeit he fluffed the start last time; career-low mark.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win a turf handicap and he was only ninth of 11 in this race last year; ran well when fifth of 17 at York over 5f last month but surprisingly found it happening too quickly over 6f at Brighton last Friday; others hold more interesting claims.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
OwnerName: S Emmet And Miss R Emmet
Spotlight: He has contested this race for the last four years, with form figures reading 1626; mostly running with credit this term and he narrowly prevailed at Newbury (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; 3lb nudge shouldn't stop him being competitive under Billy Loughnane; player.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but he's yet to finish out of the frame; recorded his best effort for this yard when third in 5f Ffos Las maiden (good; first-time visor) one month ago; this return to 6f looks a positive move for his handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: He had been upset in the stalls when unable to justify favouritism on his stable debut in June but made no mistake when making all under Silvestre De Sousa at Ripon (6f, good) four weeks ago; 8lb rise still leaves him well treated on old form and he's of firm interest.

RaceName: Betway Grey Horse Handicap
Spotlight: Dual turf winner who normally plies her trade in a lower grade and her second of six a fortnight ago came in a classified event; 7lb out of the handicap and will likely find this too tall an order.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Switching to fences has reaped benefits, backing up his opening Stratford win with an authoritative display under 5lb claimer at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; evens favourite); another 5lb higher today; Sean Bowen is back aboard; strong likelihood of better to come, and stable won this last year, so he is the one to beat.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Point winner; maintained unbeaten rules record, landing the odds in a 2m4f novices' hurdle at Sedgefield (good to soft) in February; that form has been boosted by the runner-up (four wins since) who now has a mark of 128, so this one has claims going over fences from his opening mark of 124; likely to be a threat if fully primed.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: In contention when running out at the last at Kilbeggan (2m4f) in June on final start for Joseph O'Brien, before leaving him for 50,000gns; cheekpieces added for this third start over fences (stable debut) and there's no denying that this former pretty useful Flat-racer possesses a fair chunk of ability.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Regular winner in France for Joel Boisnard, including over fences at Loudeac (2m5f) and Meral (2m2f); has held his own since moving to the UK, second at Uttoxeter (2m4f; in a reapplied hood) three weeks ago; should prove capable of winning more races, but not necessarily this one.

RaceName: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won twice over hurdles for Stuart Crawford, latterly at Ayr (2m4f) in November 2024; has gone the wrong way and competes from 14lb out of the handicap on this fourth run for current trainer, having had wind surgery since latest; by far the least likely candidate.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in two 5f Beverley outings, latterly on Wednesday; outsider.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Promise when sixth of 15 in a warm 6f maiden on Glorious Goodwood debut (good to firm) 18 days ago; likely improver for an in-form stable which won this in 2023.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: From a good family and displayed promise when 4.5l second to a well-touted newcomer from the Crisford stable over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; the third has boosted that form by winning since; can be expected to improve.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Minor late headway when seventh of ten on 5f Beverley debut (good to firm) on Wednesday; needs to leave that well behind turned out again quickly.

RaceName: Racing For Tamara Ripon Hornblower EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Mehmas filly who got up on the line to make a winning debut at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely to progress and the one to beat for in-form Ed Bethell.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: All five wins have come on the AW, including twice over C&D last winter; encouraging turf return at Newmarket in May hasn't been built on, cheekpieces tried last time now ditched; back on favoured surface but races off 15lb higher mark.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
Spotlight: Five-time winner at the track at 5f-8f, including 4-runner minor contest last winter; out of form on turf in first half of season and last month's AW return leaves him with a fair bit to find with some of these.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Group 2 Richmond Stakes winner in 2024; sparingly raced last year, including third of 5 behind Valiant Force in 5f conditions event here; never sighted on seasonal return in Naas Listed in May and has had time off since (gelded); first-time headgear combination for handicap debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Michael Scaife/Liam Ferguson/Simon Murphy/H S Khunkhuna
Spotlight: Won four for Clive Cox, including the Group 2 Temple Stakes in 2024; first win since came here last month in 5f handicap (first-time blinkers) coming off strong pace to reel in long-time leader late on (Collective Power, Fox In Flight and Valiant Force behind); 5lb higher now but still on an okay mark.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan
Spotlight: Five wins include twice over C&D and valuable Lingfield handicap in the spring; contesting premier turf handicaps of late, notably close third in Rockingham (Curragh), not clear run in the Ahonoora at Galway last time (7f); back to optimum trip now and one to consider.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Exors of the Late Mrs S Power
Spotlight: Six-time course winner (four at this trip) and has gone close a few times this year, including last month when strong-finishing third (beaten 0.75l) to Kerdos over 5f, having had to be switched; big player now at his more favoured trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Fairyhouse winner has been running well this season but yet to get his head in front, most recently faring best of those racing stands' side when chasing home a rapid improver at Naas last month; 0-5 on AW but close second over C&D in April when last seen here; definite player with rider's claim a positive.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Admirable sort whose seven wins include twice here over 5f, notably 0.5l defeat of Collective Power in April; arrives here on the back of two good runs over 5f at the Curragh but remains vulnerable at this trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: C&D maiden winner in April before adding Cork handicap over 5f; wasn't beaten far over same C&D last month on ground plenty quick; should appreciate return to 6f on this surface; likes to force it and has the ideal draw.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Dual C&D winner (from 7 career wins) but relatively lightly raced in recent years without success; absent for a year and starts off with a new trainer off much-reduced mark (3lb wrong).

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 5f maiden here last December and several good runs in defeat since including Cork second and close fifth to Kerdos here last month (5f); never competitive in valuable Cork handicap latest when 3lb out of handicap; 4lb wrong here.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "Download Our App" Mourne Handicap
OwnerName: Elaine Shevlin & Cormac Farrell & Ms Denise McCourt
Spotlight: Won a 7f maiden here last October but hasn't really gone on from that, much the best effort when third behind Cuban Grey here over 5f in May; soon beaten following month at Fairyhouse; back from a break and tough task from 7lb out of handicap.

RaceName: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has offered little in his three runs to date; off ten months before coming in eighth of nine in 7f Wolverhampton novice last month; hard to warm to.

RaceName: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair form when placed over 7f on all three outings, latest when third in Wolverhampton maiden 29 days ago; that form is working out well so he holds leading claims; cheekpieces added.

RaceName: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 5-1, made a promising start when second of four in 1m novice at Newcastle in March; off since but this son of Night Of Thunder remains with potential and must enter calculations with yard going well.

RaceName: Skopes At Meadowhall Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hooded and took a big step forward from her debut (for Ed Walker) when fourth of eight in 6f Nottingham maiden 25 days ago; this daughter of Kodiac may do better still.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: 7f specialist, not beaten far in Ascot's Victoria Cup (good) and Buckingham Palace Stakes (good to firm) in first half of this year; never able to challenge over same C&D last time; this is less competitive and he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
OwnerName: Sir M Arbib,B Arbib,C Budgett & A Kheir
Spotlight: Unplaced all five starts since winning his first two races, but there have been excuses; shaped well after making much of the running in the Royal Hunt Cup, and then used up too much energy from a wide draw in the Golden Mile at Goodwood; dropping back from 1m to 7f is an interesting move and he still has untapped potential.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Hard to predict; followed six duck eggs with a last-gasp win at Thirsk (1m, good) two weeks ago, only to run poorly again at Haydock last week; just 2lb higher than for the win but can't be relied on.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Often blows the start; everything clicked when she won at Yarmouth (7f, good) in April but she's been more miss than hit otherwise this year; others have less to prove.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Reappeared with a convincing C&D win (good ground) but hasn't built on that at all; gelded before finishing down the field at Ascot three weeks ago and now cheekpieces are fitted; needs to get back on track.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Has some solid 6f form this year, including when chasing home subsequent Wokingham winner Double Rush at Newmarket; far from disgraced from unfavourable draw at York three weeks ago; big player if seeing out today's extra yardage.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: Seemed in the doldrums prior to third of ten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last Saturday; had slipped in the weights and he's well treated on the pick of his 3yo form; not ruled out.

RaceName: TPT Fire Handicap
Spotlight: 0-8 this season but he's been bubbling under, and he'd have gone close to winning at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday but for being badly hampered inside the final 1f; dangerous if he's fully recovered from that.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: She recorded two AW handicap wins by a neck in the spring; raced freely when well-held second of five over C&D in June but back on track with solid third off this mark at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) five weeks ago; new hood is probably a good addition as she tackles this trip for a second time.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Unraced at two; off the mark on third start when taking 1m2f Pontefract maiden with authority in June; similar form when third on handicap debut at Epsom (1m4f, good) one month later and her latest outing, when she disappointed over this trip at Sandown, came in a messy three-runner affair; cheekpieces go on and she's not one to give up on.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Relished the step up to this sort of trip when she obliterated three-runner Doncaster handicap seven weeks ago; impossible to accurately assess what she achieved that day but the handicapper came up with a 10lb jolt of improvement; fascinating to see what comes next.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Very similar form in three 1m4f novices (AW/good) and she bustled up a subsequent handicap winner on the second of them at Thirsk in June; goes up in trip for her handicap debut and she's one to consider.

RaceName: Betway Bet £10 Get £40 Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressed from a low base last July/September, winning at up to 2m; quiet on her first two starts this summer following wind surgery, but she was back in the groove when second of 13 at York (extended 2m, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) three weeks ago; tackles a classier event this time but can't be dismissed.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Said to have drawn benefit from the application of cheekpieces when game C&D winner (16-1; Summergrounds a close fourth) five weeks ago; boasts a solid C&D record (1U31) so a 2lb rise in the handicap could be manageable; one of three for Russell & Scudamore.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up in this last year, and again chased home Moonbow the following month; close fourth to Lets Mingle over C&D five weeks ago; is 2lb better off with that reopposing rival, and the 10lb claimer Ella McGarry takes over in the saddle; merits respect.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: M Lee, D Lee, C Jolley & Neville
Spotlight: In fine form earlier this year, notching a hurdles hat-trick at Sedgefield (2m1f-2m4f; rising 16lb); reportedly stopped quickly when beaten favourite over 2m here (last of 12, beaten 42l) in June; it's possible that we might see the best version of this 6yo off a ten-week absence.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Infrequent winner (2-40); has plied his trade exclusively over fences since May 2024, lacking for fluency when runner-up to Conquer The Breeze here (2m) last month; monitor only, with Lets Mingle the pick of the Russell & Scudamore trio.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back in trip, and readily resumed winning ways here (2m, good; 14-1) five weeks ago; that was in a Class 5 (0-105) so he has more on his plate in a 0-120 from this 6lb higher mark; one of two for Mike Smith, with Murray Dodd able to claim his full 5lb allowance this time.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Better over fences than hurdles, notching back-to-back Musselburgh chase wins (2m4f) last November/December; tough task in Carlisle Class 2 (beaten 38l) when last seen 146 days ago; this should bring her on with a return to fences (rated 5lb higher) likely.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Four course wins (all over 2m); lacked the pace to challenge when third over that trip here (good; 4-1) early last month; finished down the field back on the Flat (1m2f) since; stablemate Follow Charlie has more to recommend.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Sole win came in a juvenile hurdle at Down Royal (2m1f) in September 2023; runner-up over 2m here (handicap debut) in July 2024, but all downhill since; soundly beaten when last seen three months ago; needs the added cheekpieces to spark a major revival; focus elsewhere.

RaceName: IM Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Charlie Johnston (8.5f-12.5f); yet to score over hurdles (0-7) but doesn't have a massive amount to find with Lets Mingle and Summergrounds based on their recent C&D clash; the task isn't an impossible one.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 6-21 on AW as opposed to 0-16 on turf; the handicapper has been in command so far this year but he is edging down the weights and may yet come good on grass; refused to race in last season's Ayr Silver Cup.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: In fine form in the second half of 2025, winning five times; ran his best race this season when fourth of six at Windsor (5f, good to soft) when last seen in June; on a winning mark but slower ground would be preferable.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times in the first half of 2026 but she has come up short in Class 4 events on her last two starts; 2-3 over C&D but perhaps a shade high in the weights for now.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 7f win at Kempton (cheekpieces first time); well beaten at Goodwood 17 days ago on his return from a 175-day break (gelded during the absence); better than that but still not easily recommended.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 4lb lower than when third of 15 in this race last year; yet to strike in 2026 but there have been some good runs along the way, including his last two starts; looks the likeliest to grab the far rail if the field split into two groups; one to consider.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Impressive in this race in 2024 when rated 3lb higher; mixed bag this summer but his two best turf runs have come over C&D and this represents an ease in grade; can't rule out.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Better known for his exploits over further but he ran well for second in a C&D handicap last August; several good runs in defeat this year but this looks a competitive race in which to end a two-year drought.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on this year's best, including a close fourth over C&D in April; has had the odd excuse since and he ran perfectly well over an inadequate 5f at York three weeks ago (not well drawn); a big run could be on the cards.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a strong finish to win a 6f handicap at York last month; strong in the betting back at York three weeks ago but could manage only seventh after his rider removed his blindfold late; still has handicapping scope.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Listed win over C&D (good ground) last August; she hasn't looked ahead of the handicapper this year though and others are more appealing.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: On a good mark on his 2yo best; retains ability and he has run with credit on his last two starts; each-way shout.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Scored off this mark at Thirsk in May; has generally run to form since but he hasn't been at his best in two visits to Ripon; new headgear tried this afternoon.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs C M Clarke, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd
Spotlight: Took a while to exploit his drop in the weights but he won at Doncaster in July and went in again at Southwell nine days ago; 4lb higher in a better race but he has the rail draw to help.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Two C&D wins last year and he is now 5lb lower than for the second of them; needs to bounce back from some modest efforts but that's quite possible under these conditions.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key return to turf at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; should be well treated but he comes with risks attached.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Underwent a second wind operation prior to her return to action in May and it appears to have done the trick, as she followed her breakthrough win at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) with a comfortable success at Ayr (5f, good); poorly drawn at York last time (wore cheekpieces); could still have a bigger run in her.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: 5f win here off 2lb higher in May; quiet afterwards until reviving with a second of six at Thirsk last week; has a C&D win on his record but rarely seen over 6f in recent times.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: The addition of a tongue-tie saw him return to winning ways at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in June; the tongue-tie was left off on last month's stable debut and he ran creditably in fifth at Southwell; this may prove too competitive.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Low-key stable debut at York last month but she fared much better when third of 21 back there 13 days later; runs off the same mark today and she's not out of it.

RaceName: William Hill Supporting MND Silver Cup Handicap
Spotlight: Ten-time course winner; he has done enough this year to think he could add to that tally but this may prove too competitive for the veteran.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Never landed a blow over further in maidens at Down Royal and Leopardstown; eligible for a mark after this.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Modest effort on debut at Limerick last month when 22-1; may need more time and experience.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: All four runs have been here earlier in the year, notably narrow defeat in 6f maiden and didn't seem to quite get home over today's trip; absent since below-par run over 5f in April.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 1m5f turf/2m AW winner Elle Dorado Rock (RPR 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (71), half-sister to Group-placed 9.4f-11.4f winner Majeed; debutant for whom market best guide (rider has ridden a couple of winners this season).

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Belardo gelding cost 7,000euros at the breeze-ups; brother to 1m winner Bellabel (inc 2yo/US turf Grade 2; RPR 114), half-brother to winners Sumptuary Law (1m-10.3f inc 2yo/AW; 90), Classic Design (9.4f AW; 82) and Key Look (7f/1m inc AW; 70); dam 8.6f AW winner (96); unlikely one to make an immediate impact but worth a market check.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Wings Of Eagles half-brother to six winners inc Sebastian Beach (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 88), Wefait (1m2f AW/11.4f turf; 83) and Dunmore Boy (5f/6f 2yo AW; 68); dam maiden half-sister to French 1,000 Guineas winner Danseuse Du Soir; bred to want further but upwardly mobile yard so don't rule out on debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Two maiden runs in the spring were modest enough; likely to be of more interest in handicaps.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in five maiden starts, notably latest two in 6f maidens, beaten a short-head into third at Navan and ducked badly left in first-time cheekpieces (now discarded) when third at Cork last month; 7f trip an unknown but definite player if staying, despite wide draw.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Elzaam filly is first foal of a moderate maiden so little to excite on breeding.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Blue Point filly closely related to 1m winner Embiran (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Elamaz (French/Australian 1m/1m2f inc Listed; 113), Emaniya (Group-placed 1m 2yo) and Ediyva (7f AW); dam 7f winner (inc Group 3/AW; 106); encouraging recent Naas debut fifth over 1m, having travelled well into the race; drop back in trip and first-time tongue tie could prove a shrewd move.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Kameko half-sister to winners Space Tracker (6f-1m inc Australia; RPR 102), Qaaddim (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 87) and Notturno Ligure (Italian 7f-1m2f); dam sprint maiden, half-sister to Listed-placed 5f-7.4f winner Colour Of Love; debutante for whom market best guide.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Fine debut second at Leopardstown last summer hasn't been built on, although recent Fairyhouse third was a bit more encouraging; more needed.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Good 2yo maiden form at this trip and just denied on seasonal return in valuable Curragh fillies handicap over 1m in May; clipped heels when unseating at Galway latest but on overall form has leading claims here; good draw too.

RaceName: BAR 1 Betting "First For Football" Apprentice Maiden
Spotlight: Owes her high mark to finishing fourth in Group 3 Anglesey Stakes last year; not a bad effort on Fairyhouse comeback in June but later in month keen and lost a shoe when last in Curragh premier fillies' handicap; back from a break and has a bit to prove from outside draw.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 68,000gns yearling; half-brother to four winners, notably Embesto (1m Group 3; RPR 113) and Silent Film (7f-1m; RPR 105); dam French 5f-6.5f Group 3 winner (RPR 108); this Ghaiyyath colt holds a Group 2 Royal Lodge entry so rates an interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 10-1 and green when a debut seventh of eight in 7f Kempton novice ten days ago; this Minzaal colt can take a step forward.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 9-2, shaped well when fourth of six in novice at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) on his debut 18 days ago, running on late under hand riding; this son of Frankel looks to have a fair bit more to offer; big shout.

RaceName: Meadowhall X Flannels Beauty Bar EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 28-1, never-dangerous fifth of ten in 7f AW novice at Lingfield on his debut last month; this Territories colt can build on it here.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Useful handicapper, runner-up in the Bunbury Cup at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in July; however, well beaten at Ascot since and now faces a much higher calibre of opposition.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: 7f wins include the Group 1 City Of York Stakes last summer; not quite at his best this year, although a sixth in the Sussex Stakes at Goodwood last month (80-1) was no disgrace; back down in grade and returns to his optimum distance so should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Usually races at 6f nowadays but probably just as effective at 7f; seemed to excel himself in first-time blinkers when sixth of 11 in Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (good to firm; 80-1) five weeks ago; not ruled out if repeating that form.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Resurgent when winning 6f Group 3 here (good to firm) last month, leading 2f out and keeping on well; all his successes have come at that distance but under these quick conditions he should be fine back at 7f; unbeaten at Newbury and has to be considered now that he's back in top form.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Ran as well as he's ever done when second in this race 12 months ago, and he was a creditable third in Group 2 at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good) last time; solid credentials and unlikely to be far away.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Has raced only at sprint distances; ran well in the face of a stiff task when fourth of 11 in the Group 1 July Cup at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; 28-1) last month; that makes him one of the leading contenders on form but he does need to prove his stamina for today's longer trip.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; made it 3-3 when winning a big-field handicap at York (7f, good) in June with plenty in hand; lost his unbeaten record in the International Handicap at Ascot next time but met some trouble and still posted another personal best; seriously unexposed and can take this step up in grade in his stride.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Back on the up with hard-fought 7f Listed win at Chester (good) in July, before finishing down the field in Stewards' Cup at Goodwood; returning to this trip should suit but he has a fair bit to find on the figures.

RaceName: Visit Malta Hungerford Stakes (Group 2)
Spotlight: Came from behind to win the Group 3 Fred Darling over C&D (good) on reappearance; tougher assignments over 1m since, racing freely in Ascot Group 3 on latest; this return to 7f is a plus but others have more obvious claims.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: She opened her account in 7f Epsom maiden last month and took it up a notch with a winning handicap debut over C&D (also good to firm) last Saturday; wasn't done any favours by the runner-up that day and a 5lb rise looks perfectly reasonable; might be the answer.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: All starts at 5f; Thirsk maiden winner who possibly had excuses when disappointing in Beverley's Hilary Needler next time; that wasn't the case when down the field again in Newbury's Super Sprint four weeks ago; jumps up two furlongs for this handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made good progress in her qualifying runs, including when landing 13-runnner maiden at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) in June; only third of four when favourite for her handicap debut at Chester next time but the pair that beat her have ran well subsequently and her wide stall was no help at Glorious Goodwood last time; could bounce back.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved when fourth at Newbury (form worked out) on her second start and she went very close at Windsor (also 6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; possibly a little unlucky that day and there's enough in her pedigree to suggest this new trip will suit; player on this handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Fillies' Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Halted a run of seconds when justifying short odds at Lingfield last month; shaped as though 7f would be well worth a go when fifth on her handicap debut here (again 6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; respected.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive handicapper last year; took form to a new level with a Listed win at Doncaster on his seasonal return and performed to a similar level when second in the Group 3 Abernant at Newmarket in April; Group 1 company was too much to handle at Royal Ascot and a mighty performance will be needed to defy his big weight back in a handicap (12lb higher than for his narrow Ascot win last October).

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Listed winner (6f) on AW; showed himself to be smart on turf too with a 7f handicap win at Newmarket last month; wouldn't judge him harshly on his Bunbury Cup defeat five weeks ago, racing away from the main action and still in front 1f out; 4lb lower today and he looks a big player for last year's winning connections.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded prior to his reappearance and he started 2026 with a pair of AW wins; tougher going on turf this summer but he has been in deep races and his latest second at Ascot (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) has worked out well; runs off the same mark and commands respect.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Positives include a C&D record comprising a win and a second and he arrives in top form; whether he is quite well enough treated for a race of this nature remains to be seen though.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice in novice company (7f) for Roger Varian; yet to win a handicap but he has run two sound races (1m and 7f) for his new stable; returns to 6f for the first time since his debut and he should have enough pace to cope.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
OwnerName: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover
Spotlight: In good form this year, winning a big-field handicap at York (6f, good) in May and adding a C&D handicap 12 days ago (good ground; Dark Cloud Rising second); up 5lb in a stronger race and it could find him out.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Two front-running 5f wins this summer; came up short in his hat-trick bid at Pontefract four weeks ago and this is just the second 6f run of his career; others appeal more.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Improved performer this year, winning 6f handicaps at Southwell and York; only midfield back at York three weeks ago and he needs to take his form to a new level to come out on top today.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: His record over C&D reads 121 and he has slipped to a dangerous mark after three low-key runs in 2026; looks the type to revive soon but perhaps when faced with slower ground than he'll encounter today.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5 at Ripon but he has run well here; back near his best when seeing off 16 rivals at Ayr last month but a subsequent Hamilton run (5f) was underwhelming; still feasibly weighted despite being 1lb wrong but he is another who would make more appeal on a slower surface.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Fared best of the stands' side group when second in this race 12 months ago; races off 3lb higher this time around but he confirmed his liking for the track with a C&D win in April and he was better than ever when beating 16 rivals at York (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; high on the list.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Sprang a 40-1 surprise on his stable debut at York (5f, good) in May and he showed better form in defeat on his next two starts (both at York; 5f and 6f on good ground); messed about at the start when disappointing at York seven weeks ago; still of major interest from a handicapping perspective judged on his run on June 13 and he's unexposed at 6f; contender.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner; runner-up on this card 12 months ago; having a solid campaign but surprising if he was up to winning.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: 7f win at Thirsk in May and ran well over that trip at Chester two weeks later; not quite so good since and the drop to 6f isn't enough to tempt.

RaceName: William Hill/MND Association Great St Wilfrid Handicap
Spotlight: Has proved a bargain buy for connections, winning a 6f Doncaster novice on debut and showing progressive form in 7f handicaps this summer; latest York win came in a Class 4 and although he's on the up, he has more on his plate from 4lb out of the handicap.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Alain Jathiere & Khalifa Mohammed Al Attiyah
Spotlight: Is on the upgrade and no problems with ground or trip; something to find strictly on official ratings but is with a top yard and she's interesting on this first outing in Group company.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Third to the unbeaten Diamond Necklace in last season's Marcel Boussac but, while she finished further behind that rival in the Pouliches, she showed improved form to win a Listed AW event last time; just about the pick of the weights and she seems sure to run well.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has won half of her six starts but below best since posting a successful reappearance at Cagnes-sur-mer in February; not seen for five months and faces a stiff task on these terms.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Very useful juvenile whose best effort came in last season's Dick Poole on soft ground at Salisbury; below that level both runs since and plenty on at the weights; this could also come too soon after belated reappearance at Goodwood.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Stepped up a fair way on her previous efforts when winning Listed 7f event at this track last month; shaped as though she'd have no problems with 1m (backed up by pedigree) and booking of Christophe Lemaire takes the eye; there's likely more to come and she's a player up in grade.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Created a good impression when winning first three starts - including in Listed event over this trip at Longchamp - but had to settle for second on first run in Group company in Germany last time; bit to find at the weights but she's almost certainly capable of better.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Heavy ground Listed winner at Saint-Cloud in March and even better effort on good ground in Chantilly Group 2 in May; below that level on AW but interesting to see how she gets on back on turf on first run for trainer.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Placed in the Albany and in the Rockfell last year but has taken a while to come to hand this season; the signs were much more encouraging at Goodwood last time (met trouble) and she's worth a second look back up in trip (bred to stay 1m) with Ryan Moore taking over for the first time.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Placed three times in Listed company over 7f but a long way below her best behind Hassaleh last time and, while that wasn't her running, she has something to prove at these weights back up in trip.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Well beaten in the Sandringham but left that behind when winning Listed event in the French provinces last time; fair bit more needed if she's to follow up back in Group company on these terms.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Overall form has an uneven look to it but she's a smart sort on her day, as she showed when fourth in last season's Marcel Boussac and when second in Ascot Group 3 last month; Christophe Soumillon rides for the first time and claims, especially if the cheekpieces have a positive effect.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Disappointed in the Jersey at Royal Ascot (first run for Wathnan) but has strong claims on the form of her fourth place in the 1,000 Guineas; she's only had four runs and is likely capable of better and no surprise to see her bounce back.

RaceName: Darley Prix de Lieurey (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Steadily progressive sort who finished second to Timeforshowcasing (since beaten a nose in a German Group 1) in the German 1,000 Guineas in May; hasn't been seen since but won't have to step up too much on that form to play a part.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Gun Runner colt; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Trojan Warrior (RPR 94); dam 7f 2yo Listed winner (104), half-sister to 1m1f Group 3 winner Red Riding Hood; one of three for top yard that has won the last four renewals; market can guide.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Epicenter colt was an 80,000USD yearling; closely related to US 6f/8.5f dirt winner Howling Time (inc 2yo), half-brother to US winners Air Recruit (5.5f-8.5f turf inc 2yo/stakes) and Basil Flavor (1m turf); dam US 8.3f AW/9.5f turf winner; plenty of appeal on paper.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Karl Kirwan & R P Behan & Mrs John Murphy & James Morgan
Spotlight: Blackbeard colt; slowly away and never landed a blow on debut over 5f on heavy at the Curragh in March; attracted market support that day so likely capable of better and has been gelded since; top rider booked and steps up markedly in trip.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Dark Angel colt from a good family was sent off at 6-1 on debut at Leopardstown (1m, good) 23 days ago but was beaten 10.5l; major step forward needed.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Gun Runner colt one of three for top yard and preferred by Lordan; looked like he'd improve plenty for his promising debut run over 6f at Naas behind subsequent Group 2 winner Man's Best Friend when not knocked about and this longer trip should suit; leading claims.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 200-1 and never figured on debut at the Curragh six days ago; seems safe to rule out on that evidence.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Flightline colt; 950,000USD yearling; half-brother to US Graded stakes-placed 1m dirt winner Blacksmith; dam unraced sister to US 7f Grade 2 winner Cezanne, closely related to US 6f stakes winner Counterforce; one of three for top yard; worth a market check on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Sent off at 50-1 on debut at Galway (7f, yielding) and wasn't disgraced, beaten 8.5l into fourth of 8; open to improvement but a fair bit more likely needed to take this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: St Mark's Basilica colt; half-brother to seven winners inc Serpentine (1m2f/1m4f inc Derby; RPR 121), Wedding Vow (1m1f Group 2; 113) and Beacon Rock (1m2f Group 3; 109); dam placed 7f-1m4f (including Oaks; 112); impeccably bred and no surprise to see a big run on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Starman filly was sent off at 40-1 on debut at the Curragh and ran accordingly; may need a bit more time.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Arizona filly; E3,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Corolla Point (5f inc 2yo; RPR 105) and Mullins Beach (6f; 67); dam unplaced 6f-1m AW (33), closely related to US 1m Grade 2 winner Istanford; likely best watched on debut.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: 66-1 and failed to beat a rival on debut at Leopardstown 23 days ago; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
Spotlight: Starman filly; unraced dam out of maiden close relative of smart 2m jumper My Mate Mozzie; best watched on debut.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Proved her Hexham maiden win (2m4f; 50-1) was no fluke when chasing home the 119-rated Holy Joe over 2m4f here (novice; 15-2) five weeks ago; moves up in trip - stamina isn't totally obvious on pedigree - for handicap debut; low mileage.
