RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Cosy Ffos Las winner (2m4f, good to soft; from 2lb lower); it isn't easy to quantify that form, but she ran as well (if not slightly better based on RPRs) when runner-up in returning cheekpieces at Uttoxeter latest; back up in trip with Rian Corcoran's services retained; chance.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six-race maiden; beaten favourite, no match for the winner, at Kelso (2m5f novice) in May 2025, before reportedly running flat on handicap debut at Hexham the following month; off since (for 427 days) so safest to let the market guide.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing
Spotlight: Came from off the pace to make it course win number five last month, brushing off a 6lb rise for his previous C&D win; the handicapper has taken another swipe (further 6lb rise) and this is the highest mark that he has competed from in over three years; a hat-trick is a possibility nevertheless.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pounced late, ending barren spell, in this last year (neck winner off 102); didn't relish the Banks course at Punchestown in May, and nothing spectacular since over hurdles (2m1f-2m2f); returning to 3m is a positive, but he couldn't rate as the confident pick.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ex-Irish; first run for this trainer was respectable but pulled up in the 2m4f 0-120 won by Lets Mingle (runs earlier) here latest; this is an easier option, and he's 5lb lower, but with plenty to prove for the time being, not least stamina.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Promise in bumpers; low key over hurdles until showing fine attitude when scoring at Cartmel (2m6f, good; 14-1) four weeks ago; that breakthrough win came after a year off so there's potentially more to come; 4lb rise seems fair so should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fourth to Newport at Musselburgh (2m, soft; beaten 4l) last November; disappointing since, with no obvious uptick for wind surgery; handicap mark is in freefall and point win came over 3m, so there are some positives.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Limited; was struggling with over a circuit to go when a remote third over 2m4f (novice; 250-1) five weeks ago; mountain to climb on handicap debut to even threaten to reverse placings with Dolly Dior.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden over hurdles (0-21); nothing positive to draw upon since scoring over fences here (3m, soft; 7-2) last October; tailed off post wind surgery here (chase) 44 days ago; a risky proposition.

RaceName: Malcolm Group Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up on her first two starts (2m4f mares) and well beaten in a 2m maiden here (250-1) 44 days ago; makes handicap debut from 7lb wrong; younger stablemate of Burgundy Man.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Pontefract (6f) in June but below par in big-field 6f handicaps at York on his last two runs; this course scorer needs to bounce back on a rare run over 7f.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Back in fine form this summer since stepped up to 7f and he narrowly completed a hat-trick under a 7lb penalty at Ayr 19 days ago; this strong traveller merits serious consideration despite a further 3lb rise.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Kevin Frost Racing Club & Mike Humphries
Spotlight: Winless since 2024 but this veteran arrives in decent nick, runner-up at Newbury (7f) in June before a creditable tenth of 17 in 7f Ascot handicap last month; not totally dismissed.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner who comes here on the back of a respectable seventh of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap 19 days ago; possibilities from a falling mark.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Ended a losing run over C&D in July and quickly followed up with comfortable success in 7f Yarmouth handicap 18 days ago; up another 7lb now but very much one to consider in his hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Doubled her tally over C&D in June and was right back on song when close second at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) last month but has a point to prove after weakening quickly on AW a fortnight ago.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with 7f Newcastle victory and he's back in very good form of late, third of 14 in 1m handicap at Redcar a week ago; a likely player eased 1lb.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m) in June but he has failed to reproduce it in three turf outings since and came in last of 11 at Haydock (7f) eight days ago; others are much preferred.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam
Spotlight: A two-time scorer (including over C&D) for Michael Appleby last summer; well below par for his present handler this season, however, and he failed to beat a rival in 1m Pontefract handicap last time.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: The Good Racing Company Ltd & Partner
Spotlight: Gained a first win over C&D last July but well below that level in five subsequent starts, although he suffered a poor run when tenth of 12 in 1m Ripon handicap in June; cheekpieces go on after a break.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 7f scorer for Marco Botti last June; back on song for his current stable when second of 11 over C&D in June; not out of things despite a 2lb weights rise.

RaceName: Phase Eight At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt
Spotlight: Ended a losing sequence at Ayr (1m) in May and largely in good nick since, sixth of ten in 1m handicap at Hamilton two weeks ago; no forlorn hope eased 1lb.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Dean De Zoete Inglett Morris Palmer Rees
Spotlight: Showed some improvement on debut form when fifth of eight at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month, although still beaten 8l at 100-1; type to keep progressing but probably needs a big leap forward here.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 10,000euros yearling; by Space Traveller; dam 5.7f 2yo winner (RPR 81), half-sister to 1m-1m4f winner Sheila's Treat; other newcomers are more obvious types.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 55,000gns yearling; Havana Gold half-brother to winners Camelot Tales (1m2f; RPR 93) and Tempted (8.6f AW; 72); dam 7f/1m winner (108), half-sister to 1m2f-14.5f winner Rocktherunway; stable's 2yos yet to start firing (0-3) this season.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Early foal by Cotai Glory; shaped nicely when fourth of 18 over 6f here (good to firm; 28-1) last month, doing best work late on after losing his footing at halfway; should build on that run and stay this extra furlong.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100,000gns yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 1m2f/1m4f winner Lord Melbourne (RPR 107); dam French 1m2f/1m4f winner (92) from family of 1m2f Group 2 winner Loup Breton; bred to be useful and represents a leading stable; makes plenty of appeal on paper.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: £32,000 yearling; Too Darn Hot half-brother to 5f winner Love Love (RPR 76); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (100), half-sister to French 1m Listed winner Polygreen (dam of 6.5f Group 1 winner Polydream); worth monitoring in the market.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Green throughout but passed a few late on when fourth of nine at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; 33-1) three weeks ago; cost 150,000euros as a yearling and has plenty of potential; could make a big step forward.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 185,000gns yearling; by New Bay; dam Listed-placed 1m winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners My Lord And Master (Listed-placed 1m 2yo) and Zain Blue (1m), out of unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Grand Duca; local stable operates at over 20% with its 2yos and this one appeals on pedigree.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Coulsty half-brother to winners Capuchinero (6f-1m; RPR 84), Arendelle (1m; 72), Gallagher (Australian 10.5f) and Doune Castle (3m/3m2f hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Mashaahed; others preferred.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Close second of five at Brighton (6f, good to firm; 3-1) last Friday, sticking on well after running green; should improve and be at least as effective over this longer trip, but there looks to be more strength in depth to this race.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 85,000gns yearling; by Gleneagles; dam third at 1m (RPR 74), closely related to 6f 2yo winner Song Of Shadows, out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m2f Grade 1 winner Debussy; yard does well with 2yos; one of the likelier types.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; Blackbeard half-brother to winners Juan De Montalban (Group-placed 1m1f-1m4f including 2yo; RPR 109), Pintara (1m 2yo including Listed; 104) and Oxford Comma (1m2f-2m2f; 100); dam Listed-placed 1m3f AW winner (98); has a useful pedigree and holds entries in the Royal Lodge and Dewhurst this autumn; interesting debutant.

RaceName: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No Nay Never half-brother to winners Arabian Force (Group-placed 1m/1m2f; RPR 112), Sea The Casper (Listed-placed 1m-1m3f; 112) and Golden Story (1m 2yo/1m3f Listed; 103); dam unraced sister to 1m Group 1 winner Rizeena; bred to be smart, and top stable won this race 12 months ago.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: He is on a hat-trick after making all (odds-on) in small-field handicaps at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm); handicapper hasn't been going overboard and he holds leading claims once again.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Made virtually all when easily landing Ballinrobe claimer (9.5f, yielding; claimed for 15,000euros) for Ken Condon in June; handicapper was evidently watching so interesting to see what she makes of this career-high mark; one of two for Gerard O'Leary.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Showed a bit on her third start at two and, after a quiet handicap debut in June, she was always front rank before being picked off late over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago; player up 3lb.

RaceName: Betway Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
Spotlight: Joined this yard after winning a Dundalk claimer (7f, AW) in November but he's been uncompetitive in three subsequent handicaps, including at Roscommon (10.5f, good) in June; stable looks to have much stronger chances with Femme Beauty but he sports a new headgear combination so watch the market.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: In-form 4yo who won at Ascot and Pontefract (both 1m, good to firm) in July; another creditable effort when third (Jungle Ruler second) at Sandown (1m, good to firm again) 17 days ago; ought to be competitive again.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who was strong in the market when making light of a 560-day absence at Thirsk (7f, good) in May on his first outing for Ed Bethell; won going away in a style which suggests this step up to 1m could unlock more improvement; a further four-month break is of little concern given he goes so well fresh (also won on debut).

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Ran really well when runner-up in two big-field handicaps at York (7f/1m, good) in June; back close to that form when fifth of 15 at Thirsk (7f, good) a fortnight ago; has claims but he's often held up (tends to start slowly) and this isn't the easiest course to make ground up.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Back to winning ways at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month; only sixth off this mark at Redcar last Saturday but the fact he won this race off 2lb higher last year provides hope; draw could have been kinder.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Made all on his final start for Ross Burdon at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft) in June but has failed to beat a rival in two recent starts for new trainer Iain Jardine; can only be watched at present.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive since fitted with headgear and switched to handicaps, winning three times and second twice from five attempts; had next-time-out scorers behind in second/third when gaining latest win at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 22 days ago and a further 6lb rise seems unlikely to prevent a bold bid from this improving 3yo.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Back to form from out of the blue in a first-time visor when getting off the mark at the 11th time of asking at Chester (extended 7f, good) five weeks ago; plenty went his way (got a dream run through on the inner after leaders went hard) and wouldn't be an obvious type to follow up.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winning veteran, including in this race in 2021 and 2022 (fourth to Capital Guarantee last year); went close to another C&D success last month and fair third at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) since.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Successful over 1m2f at Newbury (good to firm) off this mark for Ian Williams last summer; creditable start for new yard after nine months off (had wind surgery) when third of five over 1m2f here (good) 12 days ago; entitled to build on that but 9.4f at Wolverhampton is the shortest trip he's tackled prior to this.

RaceName: William Hill World Free From MND Handicap
Spotlight: Made the frame for the seventh consecutive time, albeit beaten 7l, when second of 14 at Redcar (1m, good to firm) a week ago; holds no secrets from the handicapper but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Showed ability for Andrew Balding but sold cheaply in October 2024 and hasn't been seen since; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner has shaped as though turn was near the last twice; beaten a head by Movin And Groovin over C&D on penultimate off 2lb lower and beaten 1.25l when second of 18 at Naas (1m, good) on latest; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 7f claimer here in December; ran well in C&D handicap on last visit to this venue in April and 1lb lower now; modest turf runs last twice and drawn wide on return to the AW.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Back from a 429-day absence with a 25-1 win over C&D on stable bow last month (Famous Enough second); 4lb rise for that seems reasonable and can't be discounted but wide draw not ideal.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: David Daly & Gerard Shevlin & D Battersby
Spotlight: 3yo filly gained breakthrough win here a month ago over 7f when a 33-1 shot; just 3lb higher now and while she's drawn wide, she'll have the assistance of the champion jockey in the plate; however, stamina a query at this longer trip.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly had the run of the race when getting a soft lead to score by 1.5l over C&D when last seen in April (Beau Army second); raised 5lb for that and may not get her own way out in front again here.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: Recovered from a sluggish start to shed the maiden tag at Gowran (9.5f, gd-fm) three days ago, her first start for this yard; carries a 7lb penalty, drops in trip and her previous runs here have been moderate; slow-starting, fast-finishing second over 1m at Cork on Friday.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs P McCourt/Whyte's Stamullen Syndicate/S Sweeney
Spotlight: Is 15lb lower than when winning over C&D last summer and took a step in the right direction when beaten 3.5l over C&D on latest; eased 3lb for that run and well-drawn here; could go well at a price.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly's standout effort came when a close third at Gowran in May but nowhere near that level in three runs since; hard to fancy right now.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly made all to score by 4.25l at Gowran (7f, good) eight days ago in a first-time visor (retained); has won here over 6f and 7f and wasn't far behind Queen Leila over C&D in January; drawn to attack from stall 1 and a bold bid looks likely.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: No sign of winning potential in maidens for Noel Meade and heavy defeat on handicap and stable debut on seasonal return at Roscommon; still relatively early days but others preferred.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly off the mark at Killarney a month ago (1m, good), staying on well to get up for a 1.75l win (Beau Army third); hiked up 7lb; held behind a couple of these on last AW run over C&D in April but arrives in form and this race could be run to suit; big chance.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
OwnerName: Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray & Derek Cummins
Spotlight: Not easy to win with but often runs well in defeat; is 7lb lower than when winning over C&D in March 2025 but he's becoming difficult to predict; only midfield at Leopardstown on latest; others look more solid.

RaceName: BAR 1 Casino "Slot Games & Live Casino" Handicap
Spotlight: 3yo filly 0-6 and yet to show winning potential; well held behind Cause I Like You and Beau Army at Killarney last time; blinkers now tried for AW debut; more needed.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Beat Leffard a short-neck in a 1m2f Listed race at Chantilly last year early and won another contest at that level in October; comes into this having won a Group 3 at Longchamp 69 days ago so should run well, although task is hard considering he has to give 2lb away to all his rivals.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Mostly progressed since joining this trainer, and placed in both Listed and Group company at a mile; not at his best last time, though, and needs first attempt at a new trip to bring about plenty of improvement; hard task.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Narrowly beaten early last season by Nitoi but went on to land the 1m4f Group 1 Grand Prix de Paris on good to soft; not won since but plenty of decent runs at the highest level until his most recent; case to be made if forgiving that modest effort in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud (1m4f, good to firm) 41 days ago, albeit Cualificar was a long way ahead of him that day.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Only out of the first four once in 12 starts, that being last year's Arc on very soft, and better than ever this season, recording then matching career bests, the most recent 41 days ago in the Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud (1m4f, good to firm), when Leffard was behind; drop in trip should be fine and sure to run his race.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Not had lots of racing for his age and comes into this off a career best in the John Smith's Cup (1m2f56yds, good to firm), but this is a stiff task on his first ever try in Group company; plenty more needed to feature.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Would have to be considered a fairly major shock if he placed let alone won this considering he's only won a maiden and conditions event.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won the Grade 3 Nashville Derby last August (1m2f110yds, firm) for previous connections and produced his best performance on the figures when runner-up in the Wolferton Stakes to Map Of Stars at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); ran well against a pace bias in the Group 1 Grosser Dallmayr-Preis on debut for new trainer/owner and looks to have sound claims; Christophe Soumillon on for first time

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Runner-up in the Qatar Prix du Jockey Club in 2024 and winner of this 12 months ago, when only four lined up; plenty of decent runs since and also gelded, but comes into this off a modest effort in the Group 1 Prix Ganay (1m2f110yds, good) when last seen in April; owners' retained rider is on Map Of Stars.

RaceName: Prix Gontaut-Biron Hong Kong Jockey Club (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won a Group 2 and 3 plus placed in a Group 1 last year but that season finished on a modest note; opening two starts after being gelded were again below his best but came right back to form in first-time cheekpieces when beating Wimbledon Hawkeye in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm); trip and ground no issue, so much depends if headgear works again.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: B Hague, Mrs W Duffus & Partner
Spotlight: Won three in a row over C&D (good) in early part of last season and subsequently made the frame in three Graded novice hurdles; absent since pulled up in Kelso Grade 2 in February but will be dangerous if back on song for this Perth return.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Readily drew over 8l clear of Nap Hand to land good prize at Cartmel (2m1f, good) in June and is now 3-3 over hurdles since fitted with a tongue-tie in the spring; another 7lb higher but further progress is possible.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair Flat racer who won three of his first four hurdling starts and was creditable third in Summer Hurdle at Market Rasen (2m, good) on latest outing four weeks ago; not yet fully exposed over jumps; must be considered.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Signed off for Micky Hammond with win at Carlisle (2m1f, soft) in November and was placed on both starts for new stable in February (2m1f/2m3f, good to soft); returns from 172-day break on career-high mark but is suited by this C&D and should be fine on the forecast good ground; cheekpieces (worn once on the Flat in 2023) are refitted; contender if fully tuned up.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 2-6 over hurdles, with both wins gained from the front at Market Rasen (2m, good) this season; not sure to get her own way in this higher grade but may still have potential; respected.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No match for Filibustering when second at Cartmel (2m1f, good) on stable debut in June and has since been well beaten on the Flat but is well handicapped on some of his form for Alan King and will be suited by today's trip/ground; could have a say.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at 15th attempt, with hard-fought success in C&D (good) maiden six weeks ago; has more on his plate in this good-quality handicap, though, and needs to kick on again.

RaceName: Scone Estates Stone Of Destiny Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Thp Racing & D A Harrison Racing
Spotlight: C&D winner who was seemingly back in good form when close third in bunch-finish here (2m4f, good) five weeks ago; up in grade today but remains on a good mark; no surprise if she features.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Has progressed really well this season and notched a third success over 6f here in June; posted a good fifth of ten in 6f handicap at Newmarket (form franked) last month so must enter calculations.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who is much improved for his new yard this summer, gaining a second success in his last three runs in 6f handicap at Newmarket last month; up 4lb but that form has been well advertised since so he merits serious consideration.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive sort who notched a third victory of 2026 at Lingfield (5f) in June; went very freely from widest draw and did well in circumstances when fifth of 13 in 6f Windsor handicap last time; a player eased 1lb.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Mps Racing
Spotlight: A fair 6f maiden winner at Sligo in May and signed off for Paddy Twomey with very good second in 7f Fairyhouse novice following month; since changed hands for 40,000gns and not out of things on his yard/handicap debut after a break.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Won three times over 5f in 2025; got back on track in first-time cheekpieces with fourth of ten in 6f Chester handicap in June; no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark here with headgear retained.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (6f) in January and largely in good nick since, challenging wide when sixth of ten in another 6f handicap there last time; can make his presence felt.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Signed off for Richard Newland and Jamie Insole with victory in 6f handicap at Haydock in April; up 6lb and needs to hit the ground running for his new handler after an absence.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fairly useful 5f winner in 2025; yet to hit top form this season though, third of four in 5f Nottingham handicap last month; more is needed despite a tumbling mark.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Not proving the easiest to catch right since going in at Newcastle (5f) in February but he comes here on the back of a good second of six in 5f Newmarket handicap a week ago; in the mix if on his A-game again.

RaceName: French Connection At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark at Newcastle (5f) in January but he has failed to build on it and came in last in 5f handicaps at Haydock and Hamilton (hooded) on his last two runs; others are much preferred.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: From a smart French middle-distance/staying family; started career with two wins there early last year and although she's 0-6 since for Jean-Claude Rouget, that's mostly been in Listed races and her penultimate piece of form (1m4f) gives her possibilities on this handicap, stable and seasonal debut; the betting market should give further clues.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has rather a mixed record (had wind surgery in January) but latest start was a ready win in four-runner race at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm) last month; back up 4lb but has to be considered.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Peak efforts on AW but he won on good to firm last May and did so again when he first tried cheekpieces in eight-runner race at Ascot (1m4f; by a neck, led over 2f out) five weeks ago; back up 3lb but in the mix in small field.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beaten on his last 15 starts but placed over 1m4f/1m2f in three of his five races this term; has the form for another prominent finish and is claimer ridden for the first time.

RaceName: Swings & Smiles Supported By AP&C Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Salisbury in May and improved again when second since at Goodwood (again 1m4f on good) and Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); versatile tactically and made the running last time; raised another 3lb but looks set for another bold show.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile sort who was runner-up at Chester (12.3f, good) in May but she's not easy to predict and was tailed off in the Kensington Palace at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; beaten over 12l when 50-1 here (7f) a fortnight ago and younger legs are likely to prevail.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Duaij Al Khalifa & Ahmad Al Qassimi
Spotlight: Unraced at two; six-race maiden but in the frame all starts, including when second of nine at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) a fortnight ago; 1lb nudge a little gratuitous but she's firmly in calculations.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 0-5 but she's never been out of the first three and went fairly close when third of 12 in Southwell novice (7f, AW) six weeks ago; shaped that day like the step up to this trip will suit; makes her turf and handicap debut.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Gradual improvement across her five starts culminated with a handicap win over C&D (good to firm) under Alfie Redman last Thursday; now 4lb higher but it's highly likely we've yet to see the best of her; key contender.

RaceName: Betway Free Bet Club Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Found a weak maiden when off the mark at long odds-on in May; hasn't quite matched that in two subsequent handicaps (7f) but this return to a longer trip looks a positive; possibilities.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Midfield in a Newbury maiden (1m2f, good) in April, which she's failed to match in two AW starts since, but she's looked a longer-term project and could still be one to note on this step up to 1m4f for handicap debut.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Four starts, the best of which was her debut in May; while not beaten far on handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; second favourite) last time, she finished only sixth of seven after making most; back to 1m4f (tried it on second start) but others are more alluring.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Usually slowly away but she was able to dictate the pace and battled back well when winning at Hamilton (1m3f, good) last month; evens when creditable second of four at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) 18 days later, beaten a neck with the front two drawing 15l clear; player off same mark today.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Heavy defeats to begin with, including on soft in her only turf race, but closer on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) and she built on that with a win over the same C&D (16-1); travelled okay but got shuffled back and came wide from last place entering the straight when hitting the front late on in that 12-runner race 16 days ago, which offers the clear chance of better still to offset her 5lb rise.

RaceName: Ashley Smith Memorial William Hill Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in her two handicaps this term, running below her 2yo form; moves up from 1m2f in first-time headgear.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Below par in heritage handicap at York on latest but previously ran well in defeat in a premier handicap at the Curragh; AW debutant is bred to act on this surface (half-brother to two AW winners and dam won on AW) so could bounce back.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: C&D win came in a maiden in 2023; a couple of decent runs this term but reportedly stopped very quickly when down the field at Leopardstown latest; is 2lb below her last turf win but was well held by Iron Fist at the Curragh in May and others more convincing.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Solid AW strike rate of 4-8 including back-to-back wins here in the winter over this trip and 1m4f; is 5lb higher than when scoring over C&D in December and running okay on turf in recent starts; could go well back on his favourite surface.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-time turf winner ran a nice race to finish second at Gowran earlier this week (12.5f, gd-fm): rated 4lb higher on this surface and while he's 0-17 on the AW, he's gone close on plenty of occasions off much higher marks; chance, once this doesn't come too soon.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Running okay without really threatening to win this season; not terrible efforts the last twice at the Curragh (1m2f, gd-fm) and on latest at Galway (1m4f, yld-sft) but probably needs a bit more help from the handicapper to get his head back in front.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Has lost way since winning at Gowran in July of last year; way below best on turf when last seen in April and has been gelded; cheekpieces tried now on first start since rejoining yard; probably best watched unless backed.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Both career wins have come here, the latest in this race last year off 1lb higher; has run well in defeat over much further on turf a couple of times this term and soft ground wouldn't have suited at Galway latest; should be doing his best work at the finish.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Rock solid record of 4-6 on AW including two wins over C&D; is 2lb lower than when last winning here in 2024 and wasn't disgraced when beaten 4.25l in a premier handicap at Leopardstown last month; interesting back at this venue.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time course winner over 1m4f; remains 4lb above her most recent win here in March; shaped well over 1m5f at Down Royal on latest but this trip may be on the sharp side.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Has come up dry since winning back-to-back races at the Curragh on first two starts for this stable in 2024; positive signs at Roscommon in cheekpieces on latest and now tries a visor for his AW debut; on a dangerous mark if taking to this surface.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort came in a C&D maiden in May when a 0.5l second to an 80 rated rival; ran respectably on handicap bow at Navan (1m2f, good) but struggled upped to 1m5f at Ballinrobe latest; drops back in trip now and the return to the AW is a plus.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time C&D winner, most recently last November off 2lb lower; running okay in defeat on turf in recent starts over inadequate trips and this hold up sort could get a nice pace to aim at on return to the AW; not out of this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Boasts C&D form figures of 211; roared back to form with a win over 8.5f (yld-sft) at the Galway festival on latest; 7lb rise makes things tougher and this is harder but has to be respected given her fine record at this venue.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Red God Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent 3yo placed in a 1m maiden here in January; yet to run a bad race this term; won at Roscommon in June (10.5f, good); another fine run when a close fourth at Galway over 12.5f latest; 3lb wrong here but should give another good account.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Irish raider; without a win since 2023 and far too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but gave a good account when third off today's mark at Cartmel (3m1f, good) two starts ago and the booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye; reserve (non-runner) in the 5.40 at Tramore on Friday.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles when trained by Gordon Elliott but finished well from poor position to cause 28-1 surprise here (2m4f, good) on stable/chase debut in six weeks ago; it's probably wise to treat that form with a degree of caution but today's step up in trip ought to suit him.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Absent for 571 days after winning at Down Royal (2m4f, good to yielding) on Boxing Day 2024 and was probably flattered by his proximity when last of three on last month's reappearance outing at Cartmel (3m1f, good), having set a slow pace for a long way; remains quite tricky to weigh up as a 12yo but that recent run might have brought him on.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Made all for clearcut success at Worcester (2m7f,) last month and has now won four good-ground chases this year; should also be suited by this right-handed track but latest 6lb rise might leave him vulnerable.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Eight-time hurdle winner; generally disappointing for current stable since last summer but seemed to respond well to first-time visor when respectable fourth of 14 over fences at Uttoxeter (3m, good) three weeks ago; can feature if the new headgear continues to aid.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Well beaten on last month's stable debut at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) but made a lot of the running before fading into fourth over that C&D (good to firm) in refitted cheekpieces and a first-time tongue a fortnight later, and it's worth remembering that his only career win came in this race in 2024; goes in just the tongue-tie today; interesting.

RaceName: Brooks Macdonald Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual chase winner last year, latterly off today's mark at Hexham (3m, good to soft) in October; well beaten on last three appearances, though, and returns from five-month break with quite a bit to prove.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Son of Ghaiyyath who is on the up since sent handicapping, scoring over C&D and at Yarmouth (1m) last month; up 4lb but another bold showing is on the cards in his hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fair 1m maiden for Francis-Henri Graffard; off four months before a never-dangerous seventh of ten for new stable in 9.5f handicap at Wolverhampton in June; more is needed after another break.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Gained a first success at Leicester (1m) in June but has failed to kick on since, just seventh of ten in 1m Ayr handicap five days ago; hood is reached for now.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fair maiden for William Haggas; has made a bright start for her new handler and gained a breakthrough victory in 1m Windsor handicap 19 days ago; not taken lightly nudged up 2lb.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: A fair 7.5f winner as a 2yo; returned to form after wind surgery with third of seven in 7.5f handicap at Beverley 18 days ago; needs to back it up now.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Notched a second success of 2026 at Ripon (1m) in July and followed it with a very good third of seven off an 8lb higher mark in another 1m handicap there 12 days ago; must enter calculations.

RaceName: Luxury Looks From The Avenue At Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Scored at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December but he's not proving the easiest to catch right this season, only ninth of 18 at Galway (8.5f) 15 days ago.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Promising debut over 1m5f at Leopardstown when finished upsides Phlox; didn't finish off as well when beaten further at Fairyhouse.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Carl Anthony Howell & Mrs Pauline Condon
Spotlight: Plugged away on last month's debut over 1m4f at Limerick, but has 10l to find with fourth-placed Mawhibah.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah
Spotlight: Decent debut on rain-softened ground at Leopardstown and then beaten just over 2l by shorter-priced stablemate over this trip at Limerick, sticking to her task; second and fifth both won at Galway.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
OwnerName: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited
Spotlight: Camelot filly is related to Group winnners, and is out of one too; fair fifth over 1m5f at Leopardstown; starting to retreat when hit the rail and became unbalanced at Killarney, which exaggerated the margin of defeat; yard was quiet at the time too, so that run is best ignored.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Sea The Stars filly cost 525,000gns as a yearling; dam Group-placed 1m4f-1m6f winner, half-sister to winners Prince Of Arran (1m4f Australian Group 3/Melbourne Cup runner-up) and Souter (useful 1m/8.5f); held an Irish Oaks entry; missed intended debut at Killarney last month.

RaceName: Newly Weds Sara & Nigel Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
Spotlight: Yard won 1m4f maiden a couple of years ago with this one's half-sister Trapalanda, and half-brother Ney is useful dual-purpose performer who has won six races; dam won over 1m.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Didn't reproduce reappearance form when having to work hard for his win at 1-4 in a novice at Windsor (1m, good to soft) in June; never dangerous on handicap debut 12 days later, which isn't hard to forgive seeing as that was Royal Ascot (18-1) and the move up to 1m2f that day should have suited him well; gelded since; dropped 3lb and could still bring potential.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Started his career with two 1m novice wins on good ground and ran well in defeat next time; 50-1, however, when tongue tied for first time on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) eight weeks ago and faded to be well beaten; this race is far less daunting and his dam was a 1m1f/1m2f winner, so it will again be interesting to gauge his market strength.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: There was market interest in him when the widest draw did not play out to his advantage on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm); rallied gamely when narrow winner of a four-runner race at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) five weeks ago, for which he dictated the pace and has gone up 3lb since but he should not yet be exposed at 1m2f.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won his first four handicaps (1m/7f) and close next time; cheekpieces for both starts since (1m, good to firm) when disappointing at Newmarket and hanging right late on in a respectable ninth at Goodwood; needs to resume progress but stamina in the family makes this new trip look interesting.

RaceName: Get Following BetVictor On Instagram Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 80-1 when soundly beaten on handicap debut in fillies race at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June; won starts either side, though, and travelling best suggests she was better than the bare result when she took seven-runner handicap at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last time; up 4lb but more to give.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: He was having just his second start on turf when a ready winner at the other Newmarket track (7f, good) in May; finished runner-up on his last three starts, twice over C&D including last time under Chloe Lyons, and now takes a drop in class; has to be considered.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: It was a fourth AW success when scoring at Lingfield (7f) last Tuesday, but he knows how to get it done on turf too and his previous second of six over C&D (good to firm) was a creditable effort; has won off this mark and Billy Loughnane takes over; player.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
OwnerName: Tim Cottier, Clark, Spence And Fellowes
Spotlight: Fairly bolted up at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last July; that remains his only success but he's generally been running well this term and the handicapper is starting to give him a chance; respected.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: In cracking form since joining this yard and he was winning his third race from his last four starts when always in command at Haydock (7f, good) last Saturday; goes up another 5lb but he's progressing well.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: Started out by recording useful form on first three starts for Clive Cox but the wheels came off subsequently; 150-1 for his stable debut when weakening to be beaten 15l over 6f here last Friday; big transformation required just eight days on but slipping mark makes him worth a market check.

RaceName: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap
Spotlight: He hasn't been able to replicate his 2yo form in handicaps this year and was beaten a long way when fifth of six over C&D a fortnight ago; very hard to fancy at present.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark for the year at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) in April and he has run several good races in defeat since; he should be in the thick of the action once more.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-race maiden; hopes appear to rest on this first crack at 1m2f sparking some progress.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Successful at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last month and that has been followed by two solid runs, the latest at Beverley on Tuesday; one of three runners for Tim Easterby.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner (6f); wins at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) and Doncaster (1m, good to soft) this summer but he has come up short on his last three runs; needs more to take this.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on AW off higher marks over the winter; she has more to prove on turf but a big run wouldn't be a huge surprise.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: C&D winner but it has been over four years since she last put her head in front; retained ability last summer but she has been absent for 366 days and others look safer.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Has three C&D wins to his name, including this race in 2023; retains ability but threw away a golden opportunity at Leicester last month and a subsequent Newcastle run was below his recent best too; minor money perhaps his best hope.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form in three turf maidens at up to 8.4f this summer; could improve for the longer trip and switch to low-grade handicaps but this mark isn't an obvious gift on the evidence available.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Promising third at Hamilton (1m1f, good) a fortnight ago and confirmed herself an improved performer with a cosy win at Redcar (1m, good to firm) last week; unextended when following up at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) on Thursday; 7lb higher today but she should stay and looks to have strong claims of completing her hat-trick.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Dropped a long way in the weights since joining Ruth Carr but he retains some ability and this longer trip looks worth exploring; drawn wide but likely to be dropped in; could go well at a price.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Poor strike-rate but he arrives after a creditable third at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) last month; likely one or two will have his measure today.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Won two of her last three starts, both at Ripon over 1m4f and 1m2f; a 4lb rise for her latest win shouldn't be beyond her.

RaceName: Harrogate Comedy Festival Coming This Autumn Handicap
Spotlight: Finished third in this race 12 months ago (seven ran) before winning over C&D nine days later; unplaced in four runs this year and others look stronger.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time turf winner below best on grass so far this year and extended AW record to 0-8 when soundly beaten over 1m4f here last month; others arrive in better form.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden ran his best race to date when a 2l fourth of 14 here over 1m last month; didn't shape like he was crying out for further but his dam was placed over 1m4f here so not discounted.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Won over C&D in March and runs off the same mark here; however, soundly beaten on last three starts on turf so return to the AW needs to revive.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Ran okay in a C&D maiden here in January but hasn't built on that; failed to beat a rival on last two starts; cheekpieces now added to tongue tie; questions to answer.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins here over 7f-1m but does stay this far and has multiple placed efforts over C&D; on a dangerous mark and a recent spin over hurdles at Wexford will have blown away any cobwebs; chance with rider taking off handy 7lb.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden whose best runs have come over 7f-1m; good second on debut for this yard at Bellewstown (1m, good) but bombed out at Killarney on latest (reportedly clinically abnormal post-race); a hood now goes on; risky.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Went close at Navan last month (1m2f, good) before tailing off at Ballinrobe over 1m5f on latest; 0-4 on AW but yet to finish out of the first four; place chance if leaving that last run behind.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: First sign of possible winning potential when a 5.75l fourth of 12 at Navan (1m2f, good) last month; 3yo eased 1lb and can challenge for place money if backing that last run up.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: 4-24 on AW including three wins over C&D; is 4lb lower than when scoring here in September but his form in 2026 has been underwhelming so needs to get back on track.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Eighteen race maiden is 0-11 on the AW; soundly beaten on return from 128 days off over 1m here last month and the hood worn that day is left off; not easy to fancy.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Fine run on second handicap start at Fairyhouse in June (1m2f, good); tailed off at Down Royal on latest when favourite but soft ground may not have suited; 3yo surely capable of better than that and too soon to write off.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Bolted up at Tipperary last summer but form has nosedived since; slightly better at Gowran on latest but a bit to prove on AW debut.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Ran her best race to date when a 7.5l second at Ballinrobe (1m5f, gd-yld) on penultimate but failed to build on that when a well beaten favourite at the Curragh; 0-5 on AW and others look more convincing.

RaceName: Friday Night Lights Return Weekly From 18th September Handicap
Spotlight: Huge odds and no show in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; 2lb wrong; new hood needs to spark.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Four AW efforts better than his five turf runs (including three over hurdles), backing up his win early in the year with a second off this mark next time (both Tapeta); needs a bit more again back from five months off.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: Mrs E Bickerton And A Streeter
Spotlight: Four-time Polytrack winner who came back to form last time and is 2lb lower than when last successful (turf) last summer; often fluffs the start and is usually held up, so the bigger field won't hurt; one to consider.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Came away with an in-form rival when completing the hat-trick at Ffos Las on Wednesday (enjoyed the run of the race; now 2-2 for Millie Wonnacott); maybe won't go up by as much as the 5lb penalty when reassessed but a fair chance of going in again.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Two short-priced wins (0-50 classified, then a 0-55 handicap) before held off his revised mark at this level last time; that was another in-form effort, though, and there's no obvious reason he won't go well once more.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Back in form since returned to cheekpieces of late, latterly when beaten a nose by Belle Of Kt at Bath a fortnight ago; 6lb better off with her old rival and her last win came round here off 3lb higher, so there are reasons for optimism.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dual Kempton winner who was below-par there on Wednesday evening; victories came for headgear coming off, then for going back on, so perhaps the removal will result in a better effort, but she's some way down the pecking order.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Two wins for her new yard before finishing last of four in better company seven weeks ago; maybe the good to firm ground did for her that night but she now has to prove this mark (5lb higher than when last successful) within range.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Regressive maiden under both codes for four yards (trainer also saddles Tenadaay, who looks his best chance); hard to make a case for her back in the cheekpieces.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who has run below market expectations in four starts this year and is evidently felt capable of better; again pulled hard when a beaten-favourite nine days ago (Tapeta) and much will hinge on how he responds to a first-time hood.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of a bumper/useful jumps winner; with a good stable but weakened into modest fifth of eight on debut at Ludlow (good) in November and needs improvement here.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Out of a half-sister to a Listed Flat winner; failed to complete his first two Irish points but showed some promise when fourth in May (good to yielding), after which he changed hands for £10,000; market may guide.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Former Irish pointer; unable to justify favoritism but didn't really enjoy the run of the race when third of 11 on rules debut at Uttoxeter (good) last month; stable does well in bumpers (23% strike-rate); ought to make his presence felt.

RaceName: Scone Palace International Horse Trials National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (GBB)
Spotlight: Made promising debut for Paul Power at Tramore (good; wore a hood) in May, keeping on from the rear for fourth; new stable has excellent 27% strike-rate in British bumpers; leading contender.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Winner at Ayr (1m5f) and Musselburgh (1m4f) in June and has run well on all three starts since, runner-up over 1m3f and 2m on last two occasions; latest was quite a rare run in cheekpieces; should be bang there.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Visored first time (occasionally tried other headgear) when a hampered, running-on second of seven under 7lb claimer over 1m4f at Beverley 18 days ago and that was the best Flat result since his win in January 2024; unraced beyond that latest 1m4f on Flat (second over a sharp 2m1f as hurdler); place chance but, with a 1-30 strike-rate, probably not the percentage call.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Often a front-runner and the last six of his seven wins were on Southwell AW, with the latest in March; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well and he's back 1lb below his last winning mark but the return to Southwell (from turf) for latest outing did not spark an upturn; best watched at present.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Best of his five efforts when fourth of 11 in 1m Southwell maiden (AW) in January with a first-time hood, which has been kept since; upped in trip again today but the heavy defeats in his two handicaps (last of three in latest) means that caution is advised.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Staying-on third over 1m2f on handicap debut and duly built on that when plugging on well to get on top close home at 10-11 in a seven-runner 1m4f race at Catterick (again good to firm) 18 days later; 5lb rise demands more from her but another step up in trip today may well provide it; big chance.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Modest maiden after six races, failing to kick on in handicaps this term; tried blinkers on latest start; now it's cheekpieces and a longer trip.

RaceName: Raceday Ready With Meadowhall Handicap
Spotlight: Fifth of ten in handicap at Southwell (1m3f, AW) on latest start was his closest finish but he still has major work to do; wore cheekpieces that day and connections now turn to blinkers and an extra 3f.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
OwnerName: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier
Spotlight: By Camelot out of top-class racemare Annie Power; won his first three races last summer, a bumper and two hurdles, but the wheels have come off since; wasn't up to Graded level or smart handicaps in the spring, albeit easy ground was against him several times, and tipped up on chasing debut in May; King will fill him with confidence and has the ability to go close.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Dire form in two runs and no chance here.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Sioux Nation newcomer is half-brother to German winners Fataliste (1m1f) and Fascianata (1m7f); dam German 8.5f winner, out of German 7f Listed winner.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Top-class chaser weakend out of contention in the Galway Hurdle; ran in a Curragh 1m4f maiden (without usual cheekpieces) as a prep for that, and a perfectly respectable effort saw him run to a mark of somewhere in the mid-70s, using the runner-up as a guide.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Frankel filly from a fine Moyglare family; just beaten by a fellow 70-rated rival in an optional claimer at Sligo last week; on pedigree, this longer trip shouldn't be a problem; looking at her action the last day, probably doesn't want it too quick.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Well beaten in bumpers and rated 103 over hurdles; seemed to run well when plugging away to be fifth in 1m7f amateur riders' maiden at Leopardstown, but they went steady and she's likely flattered by the bare formline.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Poor form under both codes; no chance here.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Third in a Leopardstown bumper in March before winning on hurdling debut at Limerick later that month; both of those runs on soft; well held in Cork novice hurdle on good ground when last seen in May; this is probably a prep for Listowel.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding had run in a barrier trial before making his debut last week at Leopardstown; 16s, never a factor over 1m1f; dam is a sister to Irish 1,000 Guineas third So Wonderful, but yet to produce a winner.

RaceName: Griffin Auctioneers Maiden
Spotlight: Wootton Bassett gelding; half-brother to smart performer Mohawk (7f-1m1f inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 114); dam 6f-1m winner (inc AW 2yo/Group 3;), out of 7f Listed winning half-sister to 7f-1m1f Group 1 winner Bigstone; no star at home if he's coming here for his debut, but the market will tell us more.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner for Dermot Weld; ran twice at the big recent meeting at Galway, predictably struggling in a Listed hurdle but then running okay over 1m4f; 0-5 as a jumper but was runner-up over C&D last month; chance.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No obvious sign of ability in three bumpers at Newcastle.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: High mileage on the Flat (3-37) and has always plied his trade at a modest level; limited appeal on this belated switch to hurdling.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 0-4 in points and hasn't been that threatening in two bumpers; others preferred.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dual bumper winner who has been competitive in all four starts over hurdles, from 2m to 2m5f; cheekpieces worn on last two starts are removed; off since October but he's the standard setter.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1-10 in Irish points and pulled up in all his races over hurdles; first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: The winner of two bumpers and a repeat of the RPR he posted when second in a Southwell maiden this June would see him bang there; he was a disappointing favourite here last time when behind Brosna Town.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Poor maiden on the Flat and 150-1 when pulled up here two weeks ago.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 0-3 in bumpers and 0-7 as a hurdler; however, she's consistent and has each-way claims on peak form; tries cheekpieces.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won her only point; hooded for both runs under rules, finishing first then second in bumpers at Newton Abbot; that form is nothing to get excited about but she's a Skelton newcomer to hurdling.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Related to several winners for his connections; pulled hard when well held on his 5f debut but bettered that last time, upped to this trip, despite hanging left (both turf); yard has a poor record with 2yos on the AW but he's open to more improvement.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 16,000euros breeze-up 2yo who started 150-1 for his Windsor debut a month ago, when well held having had issues at the start;  will need a lot more from the outside stall for a trainer whose recent successes have all come with older horses.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal of a 7f-1m4f winner; trainer (also runs Postremo) on the board for the season with 2yos in the week, but wouldn't be noted for newcomers these days.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1,000gns yearling, £20,000 breeze-up 2yo who was inclined to pull hard out in daylight on his 5f Windsor debut in early summer; shaped alright in faring best of the newcomers that night but it wasn't much of a novice; has to settle from stall 10 up to 6f.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Not an awful turf debut in the spring but was beaten a long way on Tapeta recently; low-grade nurseries may well be next on the agenda for a yard also responsible for Premium Seat.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Rare 2yo runner for his yard who wasn't beaten far at a huge price on his Newbury debut; upset in the stalls and pulled hard at Ascot three weeks ago, when cracking late and, while nurseries may be his time to shine, he does look to have ability.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fair turf debut behind a useful winner in June, for a yard far from noted for 2yos, and ran to a similar level when splitting two subsequent winners on Tapeta last time; wasn't best suited by the way that race panned out and is one to consider.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to two winners, who both improved with time; trainer had a quiet year with juveniles thus far (1-23) and the market will show what's expected.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dam was happiest on soft/heavy ground and didn't win until she was a 4yo; trainer enjoying a fair season with 2yos but doesn't have a great record with them here down the years.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000gns breeze-up 2yo who was easy to back when well held on her Bath (5.7f) debut for the Newland/Insole yard in the spring; new trainer always to be respected with new recruits and the market will help with this filly, who's tried in a hood.

RaceName: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Sarah Fern, Patricia James And Partner
Spotlight: Found the seventh furlong stretching her on her debut here 11 days ago; entitled to have come on for that but it didn't look much of a maiden (winner exposed as ordinary).

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Maiden with solid placed form on last three starts; got this trip okay on handicap debut at Limerick, where he was readily outpaced by a Joseph O'Brien-trained winner; that form took a few hits at Galway, but good chance of being in the three again here.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Bolger-bred Teofilo gelding; good fourth in a hot Curragh maiden last year; okay comeback over 1m at Leopardstown, and soft ground probably the reason for a poor display on handicap debut at same track; gelded since and steps up in trip here.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
OwnerName: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited
Spotlight: Went up sharply in the ratings for two wins over shorter, but nothing wrong with her run against older rivals over this trip at Galway; valuable 7lb off and definitely capable of winning more races; went badly left off the home bend at Ballinrobe, but ran straighter at Galway.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Fair maiden form and ran respectably on handicap debut in higher-grade contest at the Curragh; outpaced before the straight over 1m1f at Leopardstown last week and going back up in trip should help.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly has been disappointing since entering handicaps; fair fourth in a Killarney claimer last month; led before backpedalling in the straight at Galway; hasn't raced beyond an extended 1m; dam's half-brother won Group 3 over 1m5f.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Ballinrobe 9.5f winner was no match for Rodeo Blues back there, but is 15lb better off here; well held when second to older rival over C&D last month; usually leads.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Front-running fourth over 1m1f at Ballinrobe, but that's not strong from, and was beaten 10l when filling same position over 1m5f at Sligo last week.

RaceName: Morris DIY Rated Race
Spotlight: Not a bad run in a 1m Naas maiden when last seen in June, beaten 14l and still looked very green; sister to 1m6f winner and smart jumper Teddy Blue; could be a different proposition in middle-distance handicaps, so not one to rule out.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Had four starts for Tom Lacey, winning a pair of 2m hurdle races and perhaps better again when a front-running third in a handicap at Cartmel (second run in cheekpieces); obvious claims with his main rival also doubly penalised.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Cherry Knoll Farm, M Ward & D Skelton
Spotlight: Won two uncompetitive events this spring (2m4f/2m) and then finished close second to main market rival over about 2m6f here four weeks ago; rated 5lb above Eternal Angel on BHA ratings but that mark may flatter him.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: On his Flat and jumps form he looks outclassed; the hood is new.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Gained both wins in 5.2f Brighton nurseries last summer; close second of four at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month, his second start this season, but didn't fire at Windsor a fortnight later; needs to respond well to first-time cheekpieces and prove himself on an AW surface.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Has rather mixed record this season but was back in good form when dominating from the front over C&D a week ago, and a recent 5lb rise is manageable if he's in the right mood again.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Came good with two AW wins in April (5f/6f) but seemed quickly to go off the boil in June; further progress is not yet out of the question but he needs a two-month break to have done him good.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing 415 Handicap
Spotlight: Placed three times over 5f/6f on turf in the spring but this is his first run for over two months and his record on Polytrack (safely held all three starts) is off-putting.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark over this trip at Roscommon in May and came home well in 10.5f claimer at Sligo last week; 1lb drop gets her back into this grade.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Completed a summer hat-trick in this last year, which was her second C&D win; mid-field run at Leopardstown, after a break, rendered her eligible for repeat bid.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Dual-purpose 5yo won at Killarney last summer and his third of 15 at that track last month was the closest he's come this term.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Respectable run in a classy Leopardstown maiden on her return, but beaten a long way on handicap debut over 1m1f at same track.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over this trip at three; won a hurdle and some good placed efforts on the Flat last year; comes here a fresh horse and ran respectably at Ballinrobe last month where met some interference.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Not shamed in four handicaps last year, but yet to place; has come down 10lb from initial mark; been off nearly nine months.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner at three and dual winner over fences last year; couple of first-fence falls in March and quiet since; okay run at Navan in June; second to Stepdance over C&D last July, off this mark, and now meets her on a whopping 25lb better terms; only second time to wear blinkers.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Recorded his second 10.5f AW win in January and is rated 15lb higher on that surface; fine effort over just shy of this trip at Killarney last month, beaten half a length by in-form mare with Tassarolo a length behind him in third.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Well-bred filly (grand-daughter of Oaks/Irish Oaks winner Sariska) is sole 3yo in here; yet to be competitive, including when 20-1 for handicap debut at Cork, and slowly away last twice; headgear.

RaceName: Strand Inn Dunmore East Handicap
Spotlight: Very lightly raced since winning a Cartmel hurdle in 2023 and coming back from a year off; has twice been second over 1m4f and stable is going better, but he's obviously opposable.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, with him 5-14 in the one discipline and yet 0-7 over fences; his turn should come as it was a fair run last time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; beaten 3l off this mark); all his winning form is about this trip.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Record of 3-12 over hurdles, the last win off this mark; had a wind operation prior to finishing tailed off on chase debut at Uttoxeter, where she was a weak 14-1 chance in a race won by a stronger-fancied stablemate; needs to better that performance.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
OwnerName: The North West National Hunt Racing Club
Spotlight: Just one completion in three runs over fences and beaten 9l on that occasion; fairly well held in his last two races over hurdles as well; he's on a fair mark if everything did come together.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Now in his fourth stable, for which he won a 2m handicap chase at Hexham in June; beaten 8l next time at Cartmel and he has form there; mark just okay but couldn't rule out as this isn't a strong race.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First start for this stable when runner-up over C&D and had the hood back on then; no match for the winner at Newton Abbot but that was behind a Skelton hotpot; respected.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Five-time winner at Sedgefield but he's a dual C&D winner and ran well enough last time at Cartmel to command respect.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hasn't lived up to her excellent jumping pedigree and she's now 0-9 after finishing a well-held second at Newton Abbot; can jump to the right so this track should suit better, but she's not overly convincing.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Record of 2-18 over hurdles and latest fourth at Uttoxeter wasn't too far off his best form; however, he's Flat bred so what he'll make of fences remains to be seen.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins (disqualified from one) and a close fourth to his name from four runs over C&D, his last success coming off 4lb higher in February; not as good or consistent now but unlucky not to go closer last time and the handicapper's given him every chance.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice in Ireland last season before closing out with two lesser efforts in Listed company; struggled for his current yard, coming a stone down the weights, and again didn't achieve much last time when fourth of five on turf here.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on Tapeta early in the year and is having his first AW run since, off a mark 3lb lower than when last successful; a poor first effort since being gelded in a tongue-tie (off here) will need ignoring though.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't look to see out 1m from the front at Goodwood last time but now the question is whether she'll have the toe for 6f round here; effectively 5lb lower today and it will be interesting to see how she goes in the market.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Keen-going maiden who's been running over further, latterly not seeing out a stiff 7f having again pulled hard; hung left more than once and the emphasis will be on speed this time from the outside stall.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Started nurseries on an unrealistic mark for Richard Hannon but has found his level again now, narrowly being denied off 1lb lower last time (best of the group that started out racing near side at Nottingham); this half-brother to a C&D winner is shortlisted.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner who ran as well as could have been expected in a Tapeta claimer on tough terms last time; that effort confirmed him still in form but there's not much wiggle room off this mark.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Handicap
Spotlight: Often makes the running, as when winning over C&D off 4lb lower in January; yet to show anything on turf, so his latest Chester flop looks best written off, but there's other pace in here.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Up a total of 13lb for back-to-back wins at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) and over C&D (good) when 2.75l ahead of Marmeladova (that rival 3lb better off now); finished last at Gowran last time (1m5f, good to firm), which is not fully explained by her new rating; can do better back here.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win over an extended 1m1f trip when landing a 1m2f Leopardstown handicap by a neck off 75 last month; her run at the Curragh last time was too bad to be true when sweating and beaten 21l in last place; finished 2.75l behind Daboya in their C&D meeting in July; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in 2024 and 2025 seasons; took advantage of a drop in grade and forceful tactics when winning a claimer over this trip at Limerick and backed that up in a Ballinrobe handicap off 72 (1m2f, yielding); not too bad in two runs at the Galway festival; good claimer takes off weight and this track may suit.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner won off 2lb higher at Ballinrobe last year (1m2f, good) and returned to the same race in May when an okay fourth of nine; something seemingly went wrong when pulled up over hurdles at Clonmel in May; others appeal more.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
