Spotlight: Bounced back to form when gaining a first Flat win on his third run for this yard over C&D last month in first-time blinkers, successful by 10l; hefty 12lb hike for that but interesting if headgear continues to work; just second over hurdles here on Thursday.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
Spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler last season, winning a Roscommon maiden; well held in handicaps, however; standout Flat run for Alan King when touched off in 1m6f Sandown handicap two years ago off 3lb higher; didn't appear to stay the extended 2m trip at Galway on his return to this discipline last time; opposable.

RaceName: Perennial Freight Handicap
OwnerName: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler
Spotlight: Yet to win after eight Flat starts but took a Down Royal maiden hurdle in May; solid effort over 1m4f at Galway last month (yielding to soft); two-day break possibly to blame when disappointed over hurdles back there last time; others appeal more.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1lb higher than for the 3m win at Aintree last October (good); hasn't approached that form in his only three races since but this is a drop in grade; should go well.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Below his best form this season but ran better at Perth (3m, good) when only 3l off the winner; unlikely to be far away.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual point winner; came readily clear in a C&D maiden here in June but he disappointed under a penalty at Worcester when easy to back; cheekpieces added for handicap debut but others have greater substance to their claims.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: He was 3lb higher when winning this 12 months ago and didn't arrive here that day in great form; did finish third at Uttoxeter two runs back so could go well, despite a modest last run when the visor was back on (in which he's effective but now removed).

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made all in a 2m4f maiden and followed that with a second in handicap company over 2m6f; finishing effort was a bit underwhelming at Perth when 5l behind Ballintubber Boy over 3m; that run leaves her with something to prove stamina-wise.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six wins divided between Flat and hurdling; has some respectable races during her losing streak but doesn't look on that good a mark.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times (once over C&D) in 2025 and has gradually worked her way back to form this year; persistently denied a clear run when close fourth at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month and will be dangerous here if her luck improves.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Not quite at best on last two turf starts but now only 2lb higher than when leading close home at Kempton (1m) in May, and this longer trip won't be a problem; a possible.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Built upon satisfactory seasonal debut when winning at Southwell (1m) in April; absent since down-the-field turf run (albeit in better race than this) in May, though, and has stamina to prove over 1m2f.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive 8yo who returned from a break with two low-key runs (8.3f/7f) in June/July; should be fine over today's longer trip and is too well handicapped to rule out but needs to up his game.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: In rear throughout when 50-1 for last month's belated seasonal debut at Wolverhampton (7f); still unexposed over this trip but has modest 1-15 strike-rate and needs to leave that recent effort a long way behind.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to his two Irish wins in 2023 but has performed well twice this month, finishing second in Windsor handicap (11.4f, good to firm) and fourth in classified race here (1m4f); this drop back in trip ought to suit; probably won't be far away.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: Ended long losing spell when holding on by a nose in C&D classified in January and has made the frame here (1m, AW/1m1f, turf) on his last two appearances; likely contender.

RaceName: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
Spotlight: 20-race maiden who was well beaten in two 1m2f Yarmouth handicaps last month; might be happier back on Polytrack but remains difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden winner last season (1m4f, good to yielding); made a cracking return to action in May when fourth in a big-field handicap at the Curragh (1m6f, good); has disappointed as favourite in two runs since at the Curragh (2m1f, good to firm) and at Leopardstown in a five-runner conditions event (1m7f, good, 4-6); capable of more.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner has scored twice on the Flat, including over C&D; latest win was in the valuable amateur riders' handicap at the Galway festival last year (2m1f, yielding) off 5lb lower; disappointed on seasonal return in that race last time; must take a big step forward from that first run, but he has tended to do so in past seasons.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Six-time winner is 6lb above his last winning mark at Roscommon in September (1m4f, soft); good second on seasonal return at Leopardstown in June (1m1f, soft) but below his best at the Curragh and Galway (2m1f, yielding) since then; slowly away and stumbled in that latest outing, which was a first try at a 2m+ trip; best form on softer.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Sligo for Willie Mullins in August 2024; failed to win on the Flat for that stable (no Flat win since 2022); ran respectably over 1m4f on stable debut here in a claimer; not disgraced in a valuable Galway Flat handicap last time (2m1f, yielding) when wearing this headgear for the first time; dropped 3lb for that.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Off since pulling up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle at Naas in January 2025; won a 1m2f Flat maiden at Roscommon in 2022 for Paddy Twomey and a Naas maiden hurdle in 2024; tough task given his absence.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner in 2022 and added a maiden hurdle last year; just okay Flat handicap runs this season before tailed off effort over hurdles at Ballinrobe; beaten 22l at Fairyhouse last time; others preferred.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Modest jumper (rated 99) is 0-3 on Flat and has been well beaten in all those outings; makes his Flat handicap bow, now upped to 2m, from a reasonable initial mark and good claimer aboard.

RaceName: Brennan's Pharmacy Handicap
Spotlight: Bounced back to form with a close third under a positive ride over 1m7f at Leopardstown last month; form of that race is questionable and she's 4lb out of the weights, but C&D winner last summer and her rider's claim helps; trainer returned to the winners' enclosure at Galway earlier this month.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: 2m4f winner at Newcastle in April and his following thirds were respectable, at about 3m; however, last two runs (2m4f) not so encouraging and has a lot of weight.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Did well over fences for Harry Derham but nothing to show for four runs since leaving that trainer, latterly tried in a visor.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Dual course winner but was behind Huckleberry Sting last time and he wants further ideally.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Strong traveller who made it 2-4 over fences with a 3m success here last month but he finished weakly when second at Worcester (2m7f); this drop in trip won't hurt; 8lb higher than for that last win but the ability is there.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Only 1-12 as a chaser but he can win again off this mark and he kept on for a close second over 2m1f here four weeks ago in a race that was staged over another 192 yards beyond the advertised distance; stays this far.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Beat three rivals in a handicap chase at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to firm) in May; however, modest last run and his good days are few and far between.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win in 68 career starts did at least come over fences but he's not in much form and 10lb out of the weights.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win this season but kept on for third at Salisbury (1m, good) in June and only faded out of contention in closing stages at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last month, having raced wide throughout; on a tempting mark now; might be the answer.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Returned from short break with two good 7f runs this spring; well handicapped if judged on those but his form has dipped since and he is yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 1m.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo who came from off the pace for emphatic success at Kempton (1m) on Monday and has now won two of his last three; also suited by this track; obvious contender under 6lb penalty.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Won off today's mark at Kempton (1m) in January but was soundly beaten after starting slowly in both turf races this summer; others look less risky.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: Won two Kempton nurseries (1m/7f) in October but has disappointed on all four starts this year; needs huge boost from the new cheekpieces.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
Spotlight: A maiden after 11 starts but hasn't been with current stable long and comes here after making the frame in two 7f Epsom handicaps last month; looks ready or another crack at 1m and this return to Polytrack won't be a problem; could have a say.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Was in better form last year when winning at Limerick over hurdles and on the Flat (1m5f, good, rated 73); largely struggled in both codes since, although ran to his mark at Killarney last month when sixth (1m4f, good); took second in a Sligo claiming hurdle last time when well treated; others make more appeal.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Cork 3yo handicap last summer off 1lb lower for Joe Murphy (1m4f, good); pushed wide off the bend when a keeping-on fourth here on seasonal return (1m4f, good), Highway Sixty One 4.5l ahead; close fourth at Killarney next time and raised 3lb for her head defeat at Gowran eight days ago (1m5f, good), shaping like this trip was worth a try; new cheekpieces on.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner at 1m6f/2m1f last year; 0-15 on the Flat on turf; moderate run at Down Royal over this trip when last seen on the Flat and poor over hurdles in his last two runs; others more likely.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Versatile mare gained a first Flat win over C&D at the 22nd attempt last month (Lariat 1.25l behind); ran to her mark over fences at Wexford last time; returns to the scene of her victory 4lb higher and could go well.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Good-ground hurdles winner ran some decent races on Flat at Navan (1m6f, heavy) and Gowran (1m6f, soft) in her opening runs this year; some poor efforts over hurdles earlier in the summer, but bounced back when runner-up over obstacles at Ballinrobe last time; chance.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Back-to-back winner on AW at 1m4f/2m earlier this year and didn't run badly back there when last seen in February (2m); 1-13 on turf and rated 21lb lower on this surface; second off 1lb higher at Tipperary in August last year, but poor at Down Royal next time when last seen on turf.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Modest form so far; well beaten in opening two handicaps on AW and was tailed off at Ballinrobe last month on his first try on turf; new headgear goes on.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Downpatrick and Down Royal over 2m6f/3m last August; 0-9 on Flat and first go in this discipline since 2024; disappointed over hurdles at Wexford last time.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Now winless from 17 Flat starts but has posted some solid runs this season, including when chasing home an easy winner over 1m4f here on penultimate; hampered at Killarney last time when beaten 7l; tries this trip on the Flat for the first time in his career; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden gelding by Frankel; has shown potential for a belated breakthrough in his three Flat runs this term, the latest when sixth over C&D (4-1 fav), where today's rider was banned for stopping riding late on (4.5l behind Lariat); others more appealing.

RaceName: Dan Cowman Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner but nothing since 2022; yet to score from 28 runs over hurdles; ran well over C&D in July when runner-up off this mark; pulled up over hurdles next time; he's better in this sphere, but long losing run drastically reduces his appeal.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has won his last two (at about 2m), beating a subsequent winner at Worcester and then nicely on top in the finish here four weeks ago; that was in a small field but they went a good clip and this far will suit; up 4lb for last time.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Quite useful on the Flat and returned from a long absence to win a small-field maiden at Newton Abbot a month ago (2m2f, good to firm); difficult to gauge what he achieved there but brings potential into handicaps off what should be a good mark.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Lightly raced mare but only five ran when fourth on handicap debut and was then tailed off at Uttoxeter; much to prove.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: The booking of Patrick Mullins was a likely factor in him going off 6-4f last time at Hexham where he raced freely and didn't last home over 2m4f; had made steady progress for this yard and, back over shorter with Joshua Thompson taking off 5lb, he should be involved.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 2023 was her year but an infrequent winner these days and latest third here over 2m4f was remote; minor honours perhaps her best hope.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Left Jedd O'Keeffe for £21,000 in May and given wind surgery; first run since when justifying 5-6 favouritism in 11-runner handicap at Uttoxeter three weeks ago (2m, good); he did that narrowly but he was delivered late, so the 7lb rise could be very manageable.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Nine-race maiden who hasn't really improved for going into handicaps (2m3f-2m6f; 0-4) and was never remotely threatening last time at Cartmel; mark continues to fall and he's in good hands, so all hope not yet lost.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Best recent run was the 9l third at Worcester (2m, good) in a race she'd won twice before; ran no race back there last time and others appeal more.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Flat winner but a longstanding maiden over hurdles and arrives here in no form; 4lb out of the weights.

RaceName: oddschecker.com Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 40-1 when pulled up on handicap debut last month; 5lb out of the weights with more new headgear tried; very opposable.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Has progressed into smart performer as 3yo, winning Listed race at Newmarket in May before fine second over 1m4f in both the Group 2 King Edward VII at Royal Ascot (to Causeway, pair long way clear) and Group 1 Grand Prix de Paris at Longchamp (to Maltese Cross, caught near line); no easy task tactically from next to rail for David Egan, and gets only 4lb weight-for-age allowance (would be 10lb in Britain), but this improving colt has a lot of ability.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Smart performer on his day; career best when beaten a nose by Silawi in Grade 1 Canadian International at Woodbine (1m4f, firm) last October; returned to near best when winning Grade 2 Belmont Gold Cup at Saratoga (2m) in June by two and a half lengths from Navy Seal; difficult to catch right but might be capable of an upset.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Signed off 5yo campaign with easy 4l defeat of today's rival Tawny Port in Grade 2 at Kentucky Downs (1m4f) in September; improved again to win Grade 2 Bowling Green Stakes here (1m3f) by a nose from Fort George (who's now 2lb worse off), running on boldly to keep his smooth-travelling foe at bay; genuine sort with sound claims.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Formerly established as high-class runner at 1m to 9.5f, winner of three Grade 1s including 2023 Saratoga Derby here; first race as far as 1m3f when winning Grade 2 United Nations Stakes at Monmouth last time by nearly 3l from Uncle's Gold, running on strongly and plenty in hand; sole Grade/Group 1 winner in the field and could thrive at this trip (dam stayed 1m4f and is half-sister to 5l Park Hill winner over 14.5f).

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Sole Group victory from four attempts when winning a Group 3 at Meydan in January (1m2f) by a nose from Arabian Light; again travelled well long way in Grade 2 Bowling Green here (1m3f) last time but was outbattled, beaten a nose by Ole Crazy Bone; clearly capable of bold show but maybe better at 1m2f.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Takes time to warm up and very strong finisher for Grade 2 win as juvenile (8.5f, firm); had an eye-catching first go at 1m3f when half-length third to Ole Cray Bone and Fort George in Grade 2 Bowling Green here (1m3f), set plenty to do in a steadily run race but again finishing well; interesting.

RaceName: Christophe Clement Turf Stakes (Grade 1) (Inner Turf)
Spotlight: Group 1 placed in Europe and took very well to US racing when impressive winner of Grade 2 Glens Falls Stakes over C&D 13 days ago; travelled well and showed fine turn of foot to beat Storm Miami by about 2l in distaff event that day; stiffer task this time but receives a handy 5lb sex allowance (it would be 3lb in Britain) and has strong claims if handling the short rest.
